0Course map & how to use this review课程地图 & 如何使用本讲义

COMP9444 is one long story: how a network of simple units can learn a function from data. We start with a single neuron (perceptron), make it trainable by gradient descent (backprop), understand why the loss functions look the way they do (probability, maximum likelihood), then learn the tricks that make deep networks work (initialisation, BatchNorm, ResNets), and finally the big architecture families: CNNs for images, RNNs/LSTMs and Transformers for sequences, reinforcement learning for decisions, and autoencoders/GANs for generation. COMP9444 其实是一条主线：由大量简单单元组成的网络，如何从数据中学到一个函数。我们从单个神经元（感知机）出发，用梯度下降（反向传播）让它可训练；再从概率与最大似然的角度理解为什么损失函数长这样；接着学习让深层网络可训练的技巧（初始化、BatchNorm、残差网络）；最后学习几大模型家族：处理图像的 CNN、处理序列的 RNN/LSTM 与 Transformer、做决策的强化学习，以及做生成的自编码器与 GAN。

1Neurons, perceptrons & linear separability神经元、感知机与线性可分

Slides: 1b Neuroanatomy · 1c Perceptrons对应讲义：1b 神经解剖 · 1c 感知机

🎯 After this section you can: describe a biological and an artificial neuron; say which functions one perceptron can compute; run the perceptron learning rule by hand; build XOR from AND/OR/NOR units.🎯 学完本节你能：描述生物/人工神经元；判断单个感知机能算哪些函数；手算感知机学习规则；用 AND/OR/NOR 单元搭出 XOR。

1.1 Why "neural" networks?1.1 为什么叫“神经”网络？

A neural network is a massively parallel distributed processor made of simple units; knowledge is acquired from the environment by learning and is stored in synaptic weights. Attractive properties: biologically inspired, good learning ability, continuous & nonlinear, fault tolerant with graceful degradation (lose a few units and performance drops gradually, not catastrophically). This is sub-symbolic processing: information lives in distributed numeric patterns, not in human-readable rules (contrast with symbolic AI such as expert systems). 神经网络是由大量简单单元组成的大规模并行分布式处理器；知识通过学习从环境中获得，并存储在突触权重里。优点：受生物启发、学习能力强、连续且非线性、容错并能优雅退化（坏掉少数单元，性能只是逐渐下降）。这叫亚符号处理：信息以分布式数值模式存在，而不是人能读懂的逻辑规则（对比：专家系统等符号 AI）。

BIOLOGICAL NEURON — KEY TERMS生物神经元 — 关键词
  • Soma (cell body); dendrites bring information to the cell body (inputs); the axon carries it away (output); synapse = electro-chemical junction between an axon and another neuron's dendrite.胞体；树突把信息送入胞体（输入）；轴突把信息送出（输出）；突触 = 轴突与下一个神经元树突之间的电化学连接。
  • At a synapse, a pulse releases neurotransmitter that crosses the synaptic cleft and changes the polarisation of the next membrane: excitatory (towards the threshold) or inhibitory (away from it). When inputs pass a threshold, an action potential (spike) travels down the axon. Myelin sheath makes long axons faster (up to 100 m/s).突触处电脉冲释放神经递质，穿过突触间隙改变下一个细胞膜的极化：兴奋性（推向阈值）或抑制性（远离阈值）。输入超过阈值时，动作电位沿轴突传出。髓鞘让长轴突传导更快（可达 100 m/s）。
  • Brain: ~100 billion neurons × ~10,000 synapses each; latency 3–6 ms ⇒ only a few hundred serial "steps" per thought, so it must be massively parallel.大脑：约 1000 亿个神经元 × 每个约 1 万个突触；单次延迟 3–6 ms ⇒ 一次思考最多几百个串行“步骤”，所以必然是大规模并行。
  • Hubel & Wiesel (1962): cells in visual cortex respond to lines at particular angles; V2 responds to more complex features → inspiration for CNNs.Hubel 与 Wiesel（1962）：视觉皮层细胞对特定角度的线条有反应，V2 对更复杂的特征有反应 → CNN 的灵感来源。

History in one line: McCulloch & Pitts neuron model (1943) → Rosenblatt's Perceptron (1962) → Minsky & Papert's book Perceptrons (1969) stresses limitations → NN "dark ages" (1969–85; symbolic AI / expert systems hit combinatorial explosion and knowledge-formalisation problems) → backprop found by Werbos (1976), popularised by Rumelhart, Hinton & Williams (1986) → SVMs/Bayesian models popular in 2000s → deep learning + GPUs (2010s) → transformers, diffusion (2020s). 一句话历史：McCulloch & Pitts 神经元模型（1943）→ Rosenblatt 感知机（1962）→ Minsky & Papert 的《Perceptrons》（1969）强调其局限 → 神经网络“黑暗时代”（1969–85；符号 AI/专家系统遇到组合爆炸与知识难以形式化）→ 反向传播由 Werbos（1976）提出、Rumelhart/Hinton/Williams（1986）推广 → 2000 年代 SVM/贝叶斯模型流行 → 2010 年代深度学习 + GPU → 2020 年代 Transformer、扩散模型。

FORMULA公式

Technically: step function if g(0)=1, Heaviside if g(0)=0.5 (the course uses the names interchangeably). Later we replace g by smooth functions (sigmoid, tanh, ReLU).严格说：g(0)=1 叫阶跃函数，g(0)=0.5 叫 Heaviside 函数（课程中二者混用）。后面会把 g 换成光滑函数（sigmoid、tanh、ReLU）。

1.3 What can one perceptron compute? Linearly separable functions1.3 单个感知机能算什么？——线性可分函数

The decision boundary w1​x1​+w2​x2​+w0​=0 is a straight line (a hyperplane in higher dimensions). So a perceptron can compute exactly the functions whose positive and negative examples can be separated by one line: linearly separable functions.决策边界 w1​x1​+w2​x2​+w0​=0 是一条直线（高维时是超平面）。所以感知机能计算的恰好是正负样本可以被一条直线分开的函数，即线性可分函数。

Function函数w1​w2​w0​Check验证
AND11−1.5only (1,1): 1+1−1.5 = 0.5 > 0只有 (1,1)：1+1−1.5 = 0.5 > 0
OR11−0.5any 1 gives 0.5 > 0只要有一个 1 就 0.5 > 0
NOR−1−1+0.5only (0,0): 0.5 > 0只有 (0,0)：0.5 > 0
BIAS TRICK (very common exam question)选偏置的技巧（高频考点）
With all input weights = +1 and n binary inputs, the sum counts how many inputs are 1. To fire when at least k inputs are on, put the bias halfway: w0​=−(k−0.5). AND of n inputs: k=n⇒w0​=−(n−0.5); OR: k=1⇒−0.5. With weights −1, mirror the idea (NOR: +0.5). Choosing ±0.5, ±1.5, ±2.5 is exactly the option list in the sample exam. 若所有输入权重都为 +1、输入为 0/1，则加权和 = 为 1 的输入个数。要“至少 k 个为 1 才激活”，把偏置放在中间：w0​=−(k−0.5)。n 输入 AND：k=n⇒w0​=−(n−0.5)；OR：k=1⇒−0.5。权重为 −1 时同理反过来（NOR：+0.5）。样卷的选项正是 ±0.5、±1.5、±2.5。

1.4 Perceptron learning rule1.4 感知机学习规则

RULE (learning rate η > 0)规则（学习率 η > 0）
Present items one at a time and compute the output g(s).逐个呈现样本，计算输出 g(s)。
  • If g(s)=0 but target is 1 → Add: 若输出 0 但目标为 1 → 加：wk​←wk​+ηxk​,w0​←w0​+η
  • If g(s)=1 but target is 0 → Subtract: 若输出 1 但目标为 0 → 减：wk​←wk​−ηxk​,w0​←w0​−η
  • Otherwise → None (weights unchanged).否则 → 不变。
Theorem: if the data are linearly separable, this rule eventually classifies all of them correctly. (Adding moves s up by η(1+∑xk2​), i.e. always in the right direction for that item.)定理：只要数据线性可分，该规则最终能把所有样本分对。（“加”会让该样本的 s 增加 η(1+∑xk2​)，总是朝正确方向移动。）

1.5 XOR needs a hidden layer1.5 XOR 需要隐藏层

XOR is not linearly separable, but it can be written using separable pieces: x1​ XOR x2​=(x1​ AND x2​) NOR (x1​ NOR x2​). Each piece is a perceptron, so a 2-layer network computes XOR. It was known in the 1960s that any logical function can be built by a 2-layer step-function network; the open problem was how to learn the hidden weights — the credit assignment problem, solved by backpropagation (next section). XOR 不是线性可分的，但可以用可分的部件拼出来：x1​ XOR x2​=(x1​ AND x2​) NOR (x1​ NOR x2​)。每个部件都是一个感知机，因此两层网络就能算 XOR。1960 年代人们就知道任何逻辑函数都能用两层阶跃网络实现；真正的难题是如何学习隐藏层权重——信用分配问题，由反向传播解决（下一节）。

ANOTHER XOR NETWORK (OR and NAND idea)另一种 XOR 网络
h1​=OR (weights 1,1, bias −0.5), h2​=AND (1,1, −1.5), output =h1​ AND NOT h2​: weights +1,−1, bias −0.5. Table: (0,0)→ s=−0.5→0; (0,1),(1,0) → h=(1,0), s=0.5→1; (1,1) → h=(1,1), s=−0.5→0 ✓. Exam questions often show 4 networks — check all four input rows quickly like this. h1​=OR（权重 1,1，偏置 −0.5），h2​=AND（1,1，−1.5），输出 =h1​ AND NOT h2​：权重 +1,−1，偏置 −0.5。真值表：(0,0)→ s=−0.5→0；(0,1)、(1,0) → h=(1,0)，s=0.5→1；(1,1) → h=(1,1)，s=−0.5→0 ✓。考试常给 4 个网络让你选，就这样把 4 行输入快速代一遍。

Practice — Section 1练习 — 第 1 节

Which class of functions can a single perceptron with a step transfer function compute?带阶跃传递函数的单个感知机能计算哪一类函数？

  1. Any Boolean function任意布尔函数
  2. Only AND and OR只有 AND 和 OR
  3. Linearly separable functions线性可分函数
  4. Any continuous function任意连续函数
The decision boundary is a hyperplane, so exactly the linearly separable functions (AND, OR, NOR, NAND, majority… but not XOR).决策边界是超平面，所以恰好是线性可分函数（AND、OR、NOR、NAND、多数表决……但不包括 XOR）。

A perceptron has w1​=w2​=w3​=+1 on three binary inputs. Which bias w0​ makes it compute "at least two inputs are TRUE" (majority)?三个 0/1 输入，w1​=w2​=w3​=+1。哪个偏置 w0​ 能实现“至少两个为真”（多数表决）？

  1. −2.5
  2. −1.5
  3. −0.5
  4. +0.5
Sum ∈ {0,1,2,3}. Fire for sum ≥ 2 → threshold between 1 and 2 → w0​=−1.5. (−2.5 would be AND of all three; −0.5 would be OR.)加权和 ∈ {0,1,2,3}。要求和 ≥ 2 时激活 → 阈值放在 1 和 2 之间 → w0​=−1.5。（−2.5 是三输入 AND；−0.5 是 OR。）

In the 2-layer XOR network with hidden units h1​=OR(x1​,x2​) and h2​=AND(x1​,x2​), the output unit has weights +1 (from h1​) and −1 (from h2​). Which output bias makes the network compute XOR?两层 XOR 网络：隐藏单元 h1​=OR(x1​,x2​)、h2​=AND(x1​,x2​)，输出单元权重为 +1（来自 h1​）和 −1（来自 h2​）。输出偏置取多少能实现 XOR？

  1. +0.5
  2. −1.5
  3. +1.5
  4. −0.5
Hidden patterns: (0,0), (1,0), (1,1). Output must be 0,1,0. Sums before bias: 0, 1, 0 → bias −0.5 gives −0.5, 0.5, −0.5 ✓. +0.5 would fire on (0,0).隐藏层模式：(0,0)、(1,0)、(1,1)，输出应为 0,1,0。加偏置前的和：0、1、0 → 偏置 −0.5 得 −0.5、0.5、−0.5 ✓。+0.5 会让 (0,0) 也激活。

Which statement about biological neurons is correct?关于生物神经元，哪项正确？

  1. Dendrites bring information to the cell body; the axon carries it away.树突把信息送入胞体，轴突把信息送出。
  2. Every neuron has exactly one dendrite and many axons.每个神经元只有一个树突、多个轴突。
  3. Inhibitory synapses push the membrane potential towards the firing threshold.抑制性突触把膜电位推向放电阈值。
  4. Myelin slows the signal to prevent interference.髓鞘减慢信号以防干扰。
Most neurons have one axon and a variable number of dendrites (Purkinje: up to 100,000). Inhibitory = away from threshold. Myelin speeds signals up (to 100 m/s).多数神经元只有一个轴突、树突数目不等（浦肯野细胞可达 10 万）。抑制性 = 远离阈值。髓鞘使信号更快（可达 100 m/s）。

Who published the 1969 book that highlighted the limitations of perceptrons and contributed to reduced NN funding?1969 年出版、强调感知机局限并导致神经网络经费削减的是谁？

  1. Rumelhart, Hinton & Williams
  2. Minsky & Papert
  3. McCulloch & Pitts
  4. Hubel & Wiesel
Minsky & Papert, Perceptrons (1969). Rumelhart et al. popularised backprop in 1986; McCulloch & Pitts proposed the neuron model in 1943; Hubel & Wiesel studied visual cortex.Minsky & Papert 的《Perceptrons》（1969）。Rumelhart 等在 1986 年推广反向传播；McCulloch & Pitts 于 1943 年提出神经元模型；Hubel & Wiesel 研究视觉皮层。

Why does the human brain need to be massively parallel?为什么人脑必须大规模并行？

  1. Because neurons are digital因为神经元是数字的
  2. Because each neuron has only one synapse因为每个神经元只有一个突触
  3. Neuron latency is ~3–6 ms, so only a few hundred sequential steps fit into a fast mental computation神经元延迟约 3–6 ms，一次快速思维只能容纳几百个串行步骤
  4. Because axons are shorter than 1 mm因为轴突都短于 1 mm
Slow units + fast cognition ⇒ the work must be spread over many units at once.单元很慢但认知很快 ⇒ 计算必须同时分布在大量单元上。

Short answer (3 marks). Explain why a single perceptron cannot learn XOR, how a two-layer network overcomes this, and what problem remained unsolved until backpropagation.简答（3 分）。解释为什么单个感知机学不会 XOR，两层网络如何解决，以及在反向传播出现前仍未解决的问题是什么。

(1) A perceptron's decision boundary is a single line; XOR's positive points (0,1),(1,0) lie on one diagonal and negatives (0,0),(1,1) on the other, so no line separates them — XOR is not linearly separable. (2) A hidden layer can compute linearly separable sub-functions (e.g. AND and NOR, or OR and AND) and the output unit combines them: XOR = (AND) NOR (NOR); geometrically the hidden layer maps the inputs into a new space where the classes are linearly separable. (3) With step functions, nobody knew how to learn the hidden weights from examples (credit assignment: which hidden weight is to blame for an error?). Backprop solved it by using differentiable activations and the chain rule. (1) 感知机的决策边界是一条直线；XOR 的正样本 (0,1)、(1,0) 在一条对角线上，负样本 (0,0)、(1,1) 在另一条对角线上，没有直线能分开——XOR 不是线性可分的。(2) 隐藏层计算线性可分的子函数（如 AND 与 NOR，或 OR 与 AND），输出单元再组合：XOR = (AND) NOR (NOR)；几何上，隐藏层把输入映射到一个新空间，在新空间里两类变得线性可分。(3) 使用阶跃函数时，人们不知道如何从样本学习隐藏层权重（信用分配：误差应归咎于哪个隐藏权重？）。反向传播通过可微激活函数和链式法则解决了这一点。

"Sub-symbolic processing" refers to…“亚符号处理”指的是……

  1. representing knowledge as distributed numerical patterns across many units把知识表示为分布在大量单元上的数值模式
  2. using explicit IF–THEN rules written by experts使用专家手写的 IF–THEN 规则
  3. processing symbols faster than a CPU比 CPU 更快地处理符号
  4. predicate logic à la FregeFrege 式的谓词逻辑
Neural nets store knowledge in weights, not human-readable rules (which is "symbolic AI").神经网络把知识存在权重里，而非人类可读的规则（后者是“符号 AI”）。

2Multi-layer networks, gradient descent & backpropagation多层网络、梯度下降与反向传播

Slides: 1d Backprop对应讲义：1d Backprop

🎯 Write the forward equations of a 2-layer net; explain why we need smooth activations; derive and compute backprop deltas; know momentum and Adam; recall practical training tips and ALVINN.🎯 写出两层网络的前向公式；解释为何需要光滑激活函数；推导并计算反向传播的 delta；掌握动量与 Adam；记住训练技巧和 ALVINN。

2.1 The two-layer network2.1 两层网络

FORWARD PASS前向传播
u1​=b1​+w11​x1​+w12​x2​,y1​=g(u1​)s=c+v1​y1​+v2​y2​,z=g(s)​
E=21​i∑​(zi​−ti​)2(sum-squared error, SSE)
Number of inputs and outputs is fixed by the task; we choose the number of hidden units.输入、输出个数由任务决定；隐藏单元个数由我们选。

2.2 From step functions to smooth activations2.2 从阶跃函数到光滑激活函数

Think of E as height over weight space — the error landscape. With step functions the landscape is almost entirely flat plateaus with sudden jumps, so the gradient is zero almost everywhere and gives no direction. Key idea: replace the step by a differentiable function.把 E 看作权重空间上的高度——误差地形。用阶跃函数时地形几乎全是平台加突然跳变，梯度几乎处处为零，无法指示方向。关键思想：把阶跃换成可微函数。

ACTIVATIONS & THEIR DERIVATIVES (memorise)激活函数及导数（必背）
σ(s)=1+e−s1​,σ′(s)=z(1−z)tanh(s)=es+e−ses−e−s​=2σ(2s)−1tanh′(s)=1−z2​
ReLU(s)=max(0,s),ReLU′(s)∈{0,1}
(Here z means the unit's output.) Note the derivative can be written using the output only — this makes backprop cheap.（z 表示该单元的输出。）导数只需用输出就能写出——这让反向传播很省计算。

2.3 Gradient descent and the chain rule2.3 梯度下降与链式法则

w←w−η∂w∂E​(η=learning rate)∂x∂y​=∂u∂y​∂x∂u​​

Backpropagation = applying the chain rule backwards from the output, re-using intermediate results ("deltas") so every gradient is computed locally and efficiently.反向传播 = 从输出开始反向应用链式法则，复用中间结果（“delta”），使每个梯度都能局部、高效地算出。

BACKPROP FOR THE 2-LAYER SIGMOID NET两层 sigmoid 网络的反向传播
δout​=∂s∂E​=(z−t)z(1−z)
∂v1​∂E​=δout​y1​∂c∂E​=δout​​
δ1​=∂u1​∂E​=δout​v1​y1​(1−y1​)∂w11​∂E​=δ1​x1​∂b1​∂E​=δ1​​
Pattern: gradient of a weight = (delta of the unit it feeds into) × (activation at its input end). Delta of a hidden unit = (sum of downstream deltas × connecting weights) × g′. 规律：某权重的梯度 = （它所指向单元的 delta）×（它输入端的激活值）。隐藏单元的 delta =（下游 delta × 连接权重 之和）× g′。
WORKED EXAMPLE (one training item)例题（单个样本）
x=(1,0), t=1. Weights: w11​=0.5,w12​=−0.4,b1​=0.1; w21​=−0.3,w22​=0.8,b2​=0.2; v1​=0.7,v2​=−0.6,c=0.05. Sigmoid everywhere, η = 0.5.x=(1,0), t=1。权重：w11​=0.5,w12​=−0.4,b1​=0.1; w21​=−0.3,w22​=0.8,b2​=0.2; v1​=0.7,v2​=−0.6,c=0.05。全部 sigmoid，η = 0.5。
  1. Forward:前向： u1​=0.6⇒y1​=0.646; u2​=−0.1⇒y2​=0.475; s=0.05+0.7(0.646)−0.6(0.475)=0.217⇒z=0.554; E=21​(0.554−1)2=0.0994.
  2. δout​=(0.554−1)(0.554)(0.446)=−0.110.
  3. ∂E/∂v1​=−0.110×0.646=−0.0711⇒v1​←0.7+0.5(0.0711)=0.736.
  4. δ1​=−0.110×0.7×0.646×0.354=−0.0176⇒∂E/∂w11​=−0.0176×1⇒w11​←0.509.
Negative gradient ⇒ weight increases ⇒ output moves towards the target 1. ✔梯度为负 ⇒ 权重增大 ⇒ 输出向目标 1 靠近。✔

2.4 Practical training tips (from the slides)2.4 实用训练技巧（讲义原话要点）

  • Rescale inputs/outputs to [0,1] or [−1,1] — otherwise backprop over-emphasises large-valued inputs.把输入/输出缩放到 [0,1] 或 [−1,1]——否则反向传播会过分偏重数值大的输入。
  • Replace missing values with the attribute mean.缺失值用该属性均值填充。
  • Weight initialisation: small random values for shallow nets; more careful schemes for deep nets (Section 8).权重初始化：浅层网络用小随机数；深层网络需要更精细的方案（第 8 节）。
  • Update schedules: online (after every item), batch (after the whole set), mini-batch, experience replay.更新方式：在线（每个样本后）、批量（整个训练集后）、小批量、经验回放。
  • Three ways to prevent overfitting: limit hidden nodes/connections; limit training time using a validation set (early stopping); weight decay.防止过拟合三法：限制隐藏节点/连接数；用验证集限制训练时间（早停）；权重衰减。
  • Tune the learning rate (and other hyper-parameters) to the task.根据任务调整学习率等超参数。
CASE STUDY: ALVINN (Pomerleau 1991–93)案例：ALVINN（Pomerleau 1991–93）
Autonomous Land Vehicle In a Neural Network: 30×32 sensor "retina" → 4 hidden units → 30 output units (sharp left … straight … sharp right). Trained by supervised learning from human actions (behavioural cloning), with a replay memory (experiences stored and randomly shuffled) and data augmentation (transformed images to cover emergency situations the human never drove into). Drove coast to coast. 神经网络自主陆地车辆：30×32 传感“视网膜”→ 4 个隐藏单元 → 30 个输出（急左……直行……急右）。用模仿人类动作的监督学习（行为克隆）训练，配合回放记忆（经验存入数据库并随机打乱）和数据增强（生成变换后的图像，覆盖人类从未开到过的紧急情况）。实现了横穿美国的自动驾驶。

2.5 Momentum and Adam2.5 动量与 Adam

In a "rain-gutter" shaped landscape, plain gradient descent zig-zags across the gutter. Momentum keeps a running velocity:在“雨水槽”形状的地形中，普通梯度下降会在槽两侧来回振荡。动量维护一个累积速度：

δw←αδw−η∂w∂E​w←w+δw​

Sideways oscillations cancel; consistent downhill motion is amplified by 1−α1​ (α = 0.9 ⇒ ×10). It also helps escape local minima and cross flat regions. When using momentum we usually reduce η to compensate for the factor 1/(1−α).侧向振荡相互抵消；一致的下坡运动被放大 1−α1​ 倍（α = 0.9 ⇒ ×10）。还能帮助逃离局部极小、快速穿过平坦区域。使用动量时通常要减小 η 以抵消 1/(1−α) 的放大。

ADAM (Adaptive Moment Estimation)Adam（自适应矩估计）
mt​=β1​mt−1​+(1−β1​)gt​vt​=β2​vt−1​+(1−β2​)gt2​​
m^t​=1−β1t​mt​​,v^t​=1−β2t​vt​​wt​=wt−1​−v^t​​+εη​m^t​​
m: running mean of gradients (momentum); v: running mean of squared gradients (per-weight scale). The hat terms correct the bias towards zero early in training because m0​=v0​=0. Each weight effectively gets its own learning rate. m：梯度的滑动平均（动量）；v：梯度平方的滑动平均（每个权重的尺度）。带帽项修正训练初期因 m0​=v0​=0 带来的偏向 0 的偏差。每个权重相当于拥有自己的学习率。

Practice — Section 2练习 — 第 2 节

Why was the step function replaced by sigmoid/tanh for training multi-layer networks?为什么训练多层网络时要把阶跃函数换成 sigmoid/tanh？

  1. Sigmoid is faster to computesigmoid 计算更快
  2. The step function's error landscape is flat almost everywhere, so gradients give no information阶跃函数的误差地形几乎处处平坦，梯度没有信息
  3. Sigmoid outputs are always binarysigmoid 输出总是二值
  4. The step function cannot represent AND阶跃函数不能表示 AND
Gradient descent needs a differentiable, non-flat loss surface.梯度下降需要可微、不平坦的损失曲面。

If a unit uses tanh and its output is z=0.6, what is g′(s)?某单元使用 tanh，输出 z=0.6，则 g′(s) 为？

  1. 0.24
  2. 0.40
  3. 1.60
  4. 0.64
1−z2=1−0.36=0.64. (0.24 would be the sigmoid formula z(1−z).)（0.24 是 sigmoid 公式 z(1−z) 的结果。）

Numerical. A single sigmoid output unit receives hidden activation y1​=0.8 via weight v1​. Its output is z=0.7 and target t=0, loss E=21​(z−t)2. Compute δout​ and ∂E/∂v1​ (4 d.p.).数值题。一个 sigmoid 输出单元通过权重 v1​ 接收隐藏激活 y1​=0.8。输出 z=0.7，目标 t=0，损失 E=21​(z−t)2。求 δout​ 与 ∂E/∂v1​（保留 4 位小数）。

δout​=(z−t)z(1−z)=0.7×0.7×0.3=0.147; ∂E/∂v1​=δout​y1​=0.147×0.8=0.1176. Positive ⇒ gradient descent will decrease v1​, lowering z towards 0.为正 ⇒ 梯度下降会减小 v1​，使 z 向 0 下降。

Numerical. Continuing: that output unit's δout​=0.147; the hidden unit (sigmoid, output y1​=0.8) connects with v1​=−0.5 and receives input x2​=1 via w12​. Compute ∂E/∂w12​.数值题。接上题：输出 δout​=0.147；隐藏单元（sigmoid，输出 y1​=0.8）以 v1​=−0.5 相连，并通过 w12​ 接收输入 x2​=1。求 ∂E/∂w12​。

δ1​=δout​v1​y1​(1−y1​)=0.147×(−0.5)×0.8×0.2=−0.01176; ∂E/∂w12​=δ1​x2​=−0.0118.

With momentum factor α = 0.8, steady downhill motion is amplified by roughly…动量系数 α = 0.8 时，一致的下坡运动大约被放大……

  1. 0.8×
  2. 1.25×
  3. 5×
  4. 8×
1/(1−0.8)=5.

In Adam, why are mt​ and vt​ divided by 1−βt?Adam 中为什么要把 mt​、vt​ 除以 1−βt？

  1. To correct their bias towards zero early in training, since they start at 0修正它们在训练初期偏向 0 的偏差（因初值为 0）
  2. To implement weight decay为了实现权重衰减
  3. To make the learning rate decrease over time让学习率随时间下降
  4. To clip exploding gradients为了裁剪爆炸梯度
For small t, 1−βt is small, scaling the estimates up; as t→∞ the correction vanishes.t 小时 1−βt 很小，把估计值放大；t→∞ 时修正消失。

ALVINN learned to steer mainly by…ALVINN 学习驾驶主要依靠……

  1. reinforcement learning with crash penalties带碰撞惩罚的强化学习
  2. supervised learning from a human driver's actions (behavioural cloning), plus replay memory and data augmentation模仿人类驾驶动作的监督学习（行为克隆），加回放记忆与数据增强
  3. an evolutionary algorithm进化算法
  4. unsupervised clustering of road images道路图像的无监督聚类
Data augmentation created transformed views to cover situations (e.g. drifting off-road) the human never demonstrated.数据增强生成变换视角，覆盖人类从未示范过的情况（如偏离道路）。

Which is NOT one of the lecture's ways to prevent overfitting?以下哪项不是讲义中防止过拟合的方法？

  1. Limit the number of hidden nodes or connections限制隐藏节点或连接数
  2. Stop training using a validation set用验证集提前停止训练
  3. Weight decay权重衰减
  4. Increase the learning rate until training error is zero不断增大学习率直到训练误差为零
Driving training error to zero is exactly what overfitting looks like.把训练误差压到零恰恰是过拟合的表现。

Short answer. Explain in words why backpropagation is efficient (why we don't compute each ∂E/∂w separately).简答。用文字说明反向传播为何高效（为何不对每个 ∂E/∂w 单独计算）。

Each partial derivative shares the downstream factors of the chain rule. Backprop computes a delta ∂E/∂(net input) once per unit, starting at the output and moving backwards; each layer's deltas are obtained from the next layer's deltas by multiplying by the connecting weights and the local derivative g′. Then every weight gradient is just (delta at its destination) × (activation at its source). So the cost of the backward pass is about the same as the forward pass — linear in the number of weights.各偏导数在链式法则中共享下游因子。反向传播从输出层开始、逐层向后，为每个单元只算一次 delta ∂E/∂(净输入)；某层 delta 由下一层 delta 乘以连接权重和局部导数 g′ 得到。之后每个权重梯度 = （终点单元的 delta）×（起点的激活值）。因此反向传播的代价与前向传播相当——与权重数呈线性。

3Probability, Bayes' rule, entropy & KL-divergence概率、贝叶斯公式、熵与 KL 散度

Slides: 2a Probability对应讲义：2a Probability

🎯 Solve Bayes'-rule word problems quickly (always on the exam); know the Gaussian / CLT facts; compute entropy and KL; know the closed-form KL and Wasserstein distance for Gaussians (used again in VAEs); explain forward vs reverse KL.🎯 快速解贝叶斯应用题（必考）；掌握高斯分布与中心极限定理；会算熵和 KL；记住高斯分布的 KL 与 Wasserstein 闭式解（VAE 中还会用）；能解释正向 vs 反向 KL。

3.1 Basics3.1 基础概念

  • Sample space Ω (e.g. 6 die faces); each ω ∈ Ω is a sample point / atomic event with 0≤P(ω)≤1, ∑ω​P(ω)=1.样本空间 Ω（如骰子 6 个面）；每个 ω ∈ Ω 是样本点/原子事件，满足 0≤P(ω)≤1，∑ω​P(ω)=1。
  • An event A ⊆ Ω has P(A)=∑ω∈A​P(ω); e.g. P(roll<5)=4/6=2/3.事件 A ⊆ Ω，P(A)=∑ω∈A​P(ω)；如 P(点数<5)=4/6=2/3。
  • A random variable is a function from sample points to a range (reals, booleans), e.g. Odd(3)=true, P(Odd)=1/2.随机变量是从样本点到某个取值范围（实数、布尔）的函数，如 Odd(3)=true，P(Odd)=1/2。
  • For continuous variables P is a density that integrates to 1. The probability of an exact point is 0; e.g. uniform on [18, 26] has density 1/8 = 0.125, meaning limdx→0​P(20.5≤X≤20.5+dx)/dx=0.125.连续变量的 P 是积分为 1 的密度。单点的概率为 0；如 [18, 26] 上的均匀分布密度为 1/8 = 0.125，含义是 limdx→0​P(20.5≤X≤20.5+dx)/dx=0.125。
  • Logic ↔ probability: P(A∨B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∧B) (inclusion–exclusion, extends to 3 events).逻辑 ↔ 概率：P(A∨B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∧B)（容斥原理，可推广到 3 个事件）。

3.2 Gaussian distribution & Central Limit Theorem3.2 高斯分布与中心极限定理

Pμ,σ​(x)=2π​σ1​e−(x−μ)2/2σ2
Pμ,Σ​(x)=(2π)d∣Σ∣​1​e−21​(x−μ)TΣ−1(x−μ)

CLT: the (scaled) mean of many i.i.d. variables with finite variance tends to a Normal distribution: n​(Xˉn​−μ)→N(0,σ2). This is why accumulated small errors look Gaussian (used to justify squared error in Section 5). μ ± 1σ, 2σ, 3σ cover ≈ 68.27%, 95.45%, 99.73%. If Σ is diagonal the multivariate Gaussian factorises into a product of 1-D Gaussians; μ = 0, Σ = I is the standard normal. 中心极限定理：大量独立同分布、方差有限的变量的（缩放）均值趋于正态分布：n​(Xˉn​−μ)→N(0,σ2)。这解释了为何小误差累积后呈高斯分布（第 5 节用来论证平方误差）。μ ± 1σ、2σ、3σ 分别覆盖约 68.27%、95.45%、99.73%。Σ 为对角阵时多元高斯分解为一维高斯之积；μ = 0、Σ = I 叫标准正态分布。

3.3 Conditional probability and Bayes' rule3.3 条件概率与贝叶斯公式

BAYES' RULE贝叶斯公式
P(A∣B)=P(B)P(A∧B)​=P(B)P(B∣A)P(A)​P(Cause∣Effect)=P(Effect)P(Effect∣Cause)P(Cause)​​
P(A) = prior (before observing), P(A∣B) = posterior (after). Denominator by the law of total probability: P(B)=P(B∣A)P(A)+P(B∣¬A)P(¬A).P(A) = 先验（观测前），P(A∣B) = 后验（观测后）。分母用全概率公式：P(B)=P(B∣A)P(A)+P(B∣¬A)P(¬A)。
WORKED EXAMPLES (lecture)例题（讲义）
  1. Medical test. Prevalence 1%, sensitivity (true-positive rate) 98%, specificity (true-negative rate) 97% ⇒ P(pos∣¬c)=0.03.医学检测。患病率 1%，灵敏度（真阳性率）98%，特异度（真阴性率）97% ⇒ P(阳∣¬c)=0.03。
    P(c∣pos)=0.98×0.01+0.03×0.990.98×0.01​≈0.01+0.030.01​≈0.25​
    Lesson: with a rare condition, most positives are false positives.启示：疾病罕见时，大部分阳性是假阳性。
  2. Light bulbs. 60% from factory A (1% defective), 40% from B (2% defective). P(A∣def)=0.006+0.0080.006​=3/7≈0.43.灯泡。60% 来自 A 厂（1% 次品），40% 来自 B 厂（2% 次品）。P(A∣次品)=0.006+0.0080.006​=3/7≈0.43。

3.4 Entropy, Huffman coding and KL-divergence3.4 熵、哈夫曼编码与 KL 散度

DEFINITIONS定义
H(p)=i=1∑n​pi​(−log2​pi​)DKL​(p∥q)=i=1∑n​pi​(log2​pi​−log2​qi​)​
Entropy = average number of bits per symbol for the most efficient (block Huffman) code. KL = extra bits needed if we designed the code for q but samples actually come from p. KL ≥ 0, = 0 iff p = q, and it is not symmetric: DKL​(p∥q)=DKL​(q∥p) (so not a true distance). 熵 = 最优（分块哈夫曼）编码下每个符号平均需要的比特数。KL = 按 q 设计编码、但样本实际来自 p 时额外需要的比特数。KL ≥ 0，当且仅当 p = q 时为 0，且不对称：DKL​(p∥q)=DKL​(q∥p)（所以不是真正的距离）。
EXAMPLES例子
H(⟨0.5,0.5⟩)=1 bit (A=0, B=1). H(⟨0.5,0.25,0.25⟩)=0.5(1)+0.25(2)+0.25(2)=1.5 bits, achieved by A=0, B=10, C=11.H(⟨0.5,0.5⟩)=1 比特（A=0，B=1）。H(⟨0.5,0.25,0.25⟩)=0.5(1)+0.25(2)+0.25(2)=1.5 比特，对应编码 A=0、B=10、C=11。

Continuous versions replace sums by integrals: H(p)=∫p(θ)(−logp(θ))dθ, DKL​(p∥q)=∫p(logp−logq)dθ.连续形式把求和换成积分：H(p)=∫p(θ)(−logp(θ))dθ，DKL​(p∥q)=∫p(logp−logq)dθ。

GAUSSIAN FORMULAS (natural log)高斯分布公式（自然对数）
Entropy of 1-D Gaussian:一维高斯的熵： 21​(1+log2π)+logσ; d-dim diagonal:d 维对角： 2d​(1+log2π)+∑i​logσi​.
DKL​(q∥p)​=21​[(μ2​−μ1​)TΣ2−1​(μ2​−μ1​)+Tr(Σ2−1​Σ1​)+log∣Σ1​∣∣Σ2​∣​−d]​
If p=N(0,I) and Σ1​=diag(σi2​):若 p=N(0,I)、Σ1​=diag(σi2​)：
DKL​(q∥p)=21​(∥μ1​∥2+i=1∑d​(σi2​−2logσi​−1))(minimised at μ1​=0, σi​=1)​
Wasserstein-2 distance:Wasserstein-2 距离：

3.5 Forward vs reverse KL3.5 正向 KL vs 反向 KL

Forward DKL​(P∥Q): weighted by P, so Q must not be small anywhere P is large → Q spreads to cover everything. Reverse DKL​(Q∥P): weighted by Q, so Q just needs to sit somewhere P is large → concentrates on one mode.正向 DKL​(P∥Q)：以 P 加权，所以 P 大的地方 Q 不能小 → Q 铺开覆盖全部。反向 DKL​(Q∥P)：以 Q 加权，Q 只需落在 P 大的某处 → 集中在一个峰上。

You fit a single Gaussian Q to a bimodal P by minimising DKL​(Q∥P). What do you expect?用单个高斯 Q 通过最小化 DKL​(Q∥P) 去拟合双峰分布 P，结果会怎样？

Reverse KL is mode-seeking: Q only has to be placed where P is large.反向 KL 是“寻峰”的：Q 只需放在 P 大的地方。

4Generalisation, overfitting, dropout — and PyTorch泛化、过拟合、Dropout —— 以及 PyTorch

Slides: 2b Generalization · 2c PyTorch对应讲义：2b Generalization · 2c PyTorch

🎯 Name the three learning paradigms; explain Ockham's razor and the training/validation/test curves; use early stopping correctly; explain dropout (training vs test) and why it is an implicit ensemble; read a PyTorch training script.🎯 说出三种学习范式；解释奥卡姆剃刀与训练/验证/测试误差曲线；正确使用早停；解释 dropout（训练 vs 测试）及其为何是隐式集成；看懂 PyTorch 训练脚本。

4.1 Three types of learning4.1 三种学习方式

Paradigm范式What the agent gets智能体得到什么Example例子
Supervised 监督学习inputs + target outputs输入 + 目标输出classify images, predict diabetes图像分类、预测糖尿病
Reinforcement 强化学习no targets, only a reward signal to maximise没有目标输出，只有要最大化的奖励信号games, robots (Section 12)游戏、机器人（第 12 节）
Unsupervised 无监督学习only inputs; find structure只有输入；寻找结构autoencoders, clustering (Section 13)自编码器、聚类（第 13 节）

Supervised learning issues: framework (NN, decision tree, SVM…), representation of inputs/outputs, pre/post-processing, training method, generalisation (avoid over-fitting), evaluation on separate train and test sets.监督学习要考虑：框架（神经网络、决策树、SVM…）、输入输出的表示、预处理/后处理、训练方法、泛化（避免过拟合）、用独立的训练集与测试集评估。

4.2 Ockham's razor & the bias of curve fitting4.2 奥卡姆剃刀与曲线拟合

"The most likely hypothesis is the simplest one consistent with the data."“与数据一致的最简单假设最可能是对的。”

Measurements are noisy, so we must trade off simplicity of the hypothesis against how well it fits the data. Outliers (e.g. the 2000 Florida "butterfly ballot" county) show why a model should not chase every point.测量带噪声，所以要在假设的简单性与对数据的拟合程度之间权衡。离群点（如 2000 年佛罗里达“蝴蝶选票”县）说明模型不应去迁就每一个点。

4.3 Training, validation and test error4.3 训练、验证与测试误差

Normally training error keeps decreasing, but validation/test error flattens or rises. Early stopping: keep a validation set and stop when its error is lowest. Be careful: validation error can be noisy or temporarily rise and then fall again — you may need to keep training to be sure what is going on.通常训练误差持续下降，但验证/测试误差会持平或上升。早停：留出验证集，在其误差最低时停止。注意：验证误差可能有噪声，或暂时上升后又下降——需要继续训练一段才能确定趋势。

WAYS TO AVOID OVERFITTING IN NEURAL NETWORKS神经网络防过拟合方法
limit hidden nodes/connections · limit training epochs (early stopping) · weight decay (Section 5) · data augmentation (Section 8) · regularisation such as dropout.限制隐藏节点/连接 · 限制训练轮数（早停）· 权重衰减（第 5 节）· 数据增强（第 8 节）· 正则化，如 dropout。

4.4 Dropout and ensembling4.4 Dropout 与集成

  • For each minibatch, randomly remove a subset of nodes (each dropped with fixed probability, usually ½).每个小批量随机去掉一部分节点（每个节点以固定概率丢弃，通常为 ½）。
  • At deployment all nodes are used, but each activation is multiplied by the keep probability, so each node receives the average input it saw in training.部署时使用全部节点，但每个激活乘以保留概率，使每个节点收到的是训练时的平均输入。
  • Forces redundancy: the network must cope when some features are missing.迫使网络产生冗余：必须能应对部分特征缺失。
  • Is an implicit, efficient ensemble: every minibatch trains a different thinned architecture on the same data; scaling by the keep probability averages over them.是一种隐式、高效的集成：每个小批量在同样数据上训练一个不同的“瘦身”结构；按保留概率缩放相当于对它们取平均。

Ensembling: train several different classifiers on the same task and vote. Benefit requires diversity (different architectures, SVMs with different kernels, etc. — the typical Kaggle recipe).集成：在同一任务上训练多个不同分类器并投票。要有收益必须有多样性（不同结构、不同核的 SVM 等——Kaggle 常用套路）。

4.5 PyTorch in one screen4.5 一屏看懂 PyTorch

net = MyNetwork().to(device)                 # CPU or GPU
train_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(...)
optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(net.parameters(), lr=0.01, momentum=0.9)  # or Adam
for epoch in range(1, epochs):
    for x, t in train_loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()                # clear old gradients
        z = net(x)                           # forward
        loss = F.binary_cross_entropy(z, t)  # loss
        loss.backward()                      # backprop: fills .grad
        optimizer.step()                     # update weights

class MyNetwork(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_in, n_hid, n_out):
        super().__init__()
        self.main = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(n_in, n_hid), nn.Tanh(),
                                  nn.Linear(n_hid, n_out), nn.Sigmoid())
    def forward(self, x): return self.main(x)

Components: layers nn.Linear, nn.Conv2d; intermediate nn.Dropout, nn.BatchNorm; activations nn.Sigmoid, nn.Tanh, nn.ReLU. Custom parameters use nn.Parameter (e.g. a model Axlogy+By2). Data via TensorDataset/DataLoader or pandas CSV. model.train() vs model.eval() switches dropout/BatchNorm behaviour.组件：层 nn.Linear、nn.Conv2d；中间操作 nn.Dropout、nn.BatchNorm；激活 nn.Sigmoid、nn.Tanh、nn.ReLU。自定义参数用 nn.Parameter（如模型 Axlogy+By2）。数据用 TensorDataset/DataLoader 或 pandas 读 CSV。model.train() 与 model.eval() 切换 dropout/BatchNorm 的行为。

Practice — Section 4练习 — 第 4 节

An agent is never shown the correct action but receives a scalar score it tries to maximise. This is…智能体从未被告知正确动作，只收到一个要最大化的分数。这属于……

  1. supervised learning监督学习
  2. reinforcement learning强化学习
  3. unsupervised learning无监督学习
  4. ensembling集成学习
Reward signal, no target outputs ⇒ RL.只有奖励信号、无目标输出 ⇒ 强化学习。

After training with dropout (keep probability p), what happens at test time?用 dropout（保留概率 p）训练后，测试时如何处理？

  1. Randomly drop the same fraction of nodes随机丢弃相同比例的节点
  2. Remove all nodes that were ever dropped删掉所有曾被丢弃的节点
  3. Use all nodes, multiplying each activation by p使用全部节点，并把每个激活乘以 p
  4. Divide all weights by the number of minibatches所有权重除以小批量数
So each unit receives the average input it would have received during training (this implicitly averages the ensemble).这样每个单元接收到训练时的平均输入（隐式地对集成取平均）。

Training error keeps falling while validation error has started to rise. The best interpretation is…训练误差持续下降，而验证误差开始上升。最合理的解释是……

  1. The network is starting to overfit; consider early stopping网络开始过拟合；考虑早停
  2. The network is underfitting; add training epochs网络欠拟合；增加训练轮数
  3. The learning rate is too small学习率太小
  4. The test set is too large测试集太大
Classic overfitting curve. (But be careful: check the trend over enough updates before stopping.)经典过拟合曲线。（但要小心：确认趋势稳定后再停止。）

Why does ensembling require diversity among its members?为什么集成需要成员之间的多样性？

  1. To reduce training time减少训练时间
  2. Because voting only works with an odd number of models因为投票只适用于奇数个模型
  3. Identical models make the vote deterministic相同模型会让投票确定
  4. If all members make the same errors, voting cannot correct them如果所有成员犯同样的错，投票无法纠正
Averaging helps only when errors are (partly) uncorrelated.只有误差（部分）不相关时平均才有用。

In a PyTorch training loop, what does loss.backward() do?PyTorch 训练循环中 loss.backward() 做什么？

  1. Updates the weights更新权重
  2. Computes gradients of the loss w.r.t. all parameters (stored in .grad)计算损失对所有参数的梯度（存入 .grad）
  3. Resets gradients to zero把梯度清零
  4. Moves the model to the GPU把模型移到 GPU
optimizer.step() updates; optimizer.zero_grad() resets.optimizer.step() 负责更新；optimizer.zero_grad() 负责清零。

Short answer (3 marks). Explain why dropout reduces overfitting, mentioning both the redundancy view and the ensemble view.简答（3 分）。解释 dropout 为何能减轻过拟合，需同时提到“冗余”观点与“集成”观点。

During training each node is randomly removed (typically p = ½) for each minibatch, so no unit can rely on specific other units being present. Redundancy view: the network must learn several independent ways to represent useful features, so it cannot memorise co-adapted, fragile combinations that fit noise. Ensemble view: each minibatch trains a different sub-architecture sharing weights; at test time all nodes are used with activations scaled by the keep probability, which approximates averaging the predictions of this exponentially large ensemble — averaging reduces variance and therefore overfitting, at almost no extra cost.训练时每个小批量都随机去掉节点（通常 p = ½），所以任何单元都不能依赖某些特定单元的存在。冗余观点：网络必须学会多种相互独立的方式表示有用特征，无法记住那些相互依赖、脆弱、拟合噪声的组合。集成观点：每个小批量训练一个共享权重的不同子结构；测试时使用全部节点并把激活乘以保留概率，近似于对这一指数级大的集成取平均——平均降低方差从而减轻过拟合，且几乎没有额外代价。

Ockham's razor says…奥卡姆剃刀说的是……

  1. always choose the model with the lowest training error总选训练误差最低的模型
  2. more parameters always generalise better参数越多泛化越好
  3. the most likely hypothesis is the simplest one consistent with the data与数据一致的最简单假设最可能正确
  4. outliers should always be fitted exactly离群点必须精确拟合
Trade off simplicity against fit because data are noisy.因数据有噪声，需要在简单性与拟合度之间权衡。

5Backprop variations: cross-entropy, maximum likelihood, softmax, weight decay & Bayesian inference反向传播变体：交叉熵、最大似然、Softmax、权重衰减与贝叶斯推断

Slides: 3a Variations对应讲义：3a Variations

🎯 Derive SSE and cross-entropy from maximum likelihood; know the beautiful gradients (sigmoid+CE, softmax+log-loss); explain weight decay as MAP with a Gaussian prior; answer "ML vs Bayesian inference" (sample-exam short answer).🎯 从最大似然推导平方误差和交叉熵；记住漂亮的梯度（sigmoid+CE、softmax+对数损失）；把权重衰减解释为高斯先验下的 MAP；回答“最大似然 vs 贝叶斯推断”（样卷简答题）。

5.1 Two loss functions5.1 两种损失函数

ESSE​=21​i∑​(zi​−ti​)2ECE​=i∑​(−ti​logzi​−(1−ti​)log(1−zi​))​

SSE for function approximation (real-valued targets); cross-entropy for classification (targets 0/1). Both come from one principle:平方误差用于函数逼近（实值目标）；交叉熵用于分类（0/1 目标）。二者来自同一原理：

5.2 Maximum likelihood (ML)5.2 最大似然（ML）

ML PRINCIPLE最大似然原则
Let H be a class of hypotheses (e.g. all networks with a given architecture). P(D∣h) is the probability of the observed data D under hypothesis h; logP(D∣h) is the (log-)likelihood. Choose the h that maximises it.设 H 为假设空间（如某结构下所有网络）。P(D∣h) 是在假设 h 下观测到数据 D 的概率；logP(D∣h) 是（对数）似然。选使其最大的 h。

(a) Gaussian noise ⇒ least squares(a) 高斯噪声 ⇒ 最小二乘

Assume ti​=f(xi​)+ Gaussian noise (justified by the CLT):假设 ti​=f(xi​)+ 高斯噪声（由中心极限定理支持）：

logP({ti​}∣f)=i∑​[−2σ21​(ti​−f(xi​))2−logσ−21​log2π]⇒ fML​=argfmin​i∑​(ti​−f(xi​))2​

Note: we don't even need to know σ.注意：甚至不需要知道 σ。

(b) Bernoulli outputs ⇒ cross-entropy(b) 伯努利输出 ⇒ 交叉熵

Interpret the output as P(1∣x)=f(x). Then P(t∣f(x))=f(x)t(1−f(x))1−t, and把输出理解为 P(1∣x)=f(x)，则 P(t∣f(x))=f(x)t(1−f(x))1−t，于是

−logP({ti​}∣f)=i∑​−ti​logf(xi​)−(1−ti​)log(1−f(xi​))=ECE​
SIGMOID + CROSS-ENTROPY: THE GRADIENT SIMPLIFIESSigmoid + 交叉熵：梯度化简
∂z∂E​=z(1−z)z−t​∂s∂z​=z(1−z) ⇒ ∂s∂E​=z−t​​
Compare SSE + sigmoid: (z−t)z(1−z) — the extra z(1−z) is tiny when the unit saturates, so learning stalls even when the output is badly wrong. CE avoids this.对比平方误差 + sigmoid：(z−t)z(1−z)——单元饱和时 z(1−z) 很小，即使输出错得离谱学习也会停滞。交叉熵避免了这个问题。

CE = KL + constant. With pi​=⟨1−ti​,ti​⟩, qi​=⟨1−f(xi​),f(xi​)⟩: ECE​=∑i​DKL​(pi​∥qi​)+H(pi​); H(pi​) is fixed, so minimising CE = minimising KL.交叉熵 = KL + 常数。令 pi​=⟨1−ti​,ti​⟩、qi​=⟨1−f(xi​),f(xi​)⟩：ECE​=∑i​DKL​(pi​∥qi​)+H(pi​)；H(pi​) 固定，所以最小化交叉熵 = 最小化 KL。

Outliers: SSE per item is bounded (between 0 and 1 for sigmoid outputs) so SSE is more willing to "give up" on outliers and misclassify them; CE grows unboundedly (logarithmically) as the output approaches the wrong extreme, so it tends to keep outliers correctly classified — good for unbalanced tasks where one class vastly outnumbers the other.离群点：平方误差对单个样本有界（sigmoid 输出时在 0 到 1 之间），因此更容易“放弃”离群点而把它们分错；交叉熵在输出趋近错误极端时无界地（对数）增长，因此倾向于把离群点也分对——适合一类样本远多于另一类的不平衡任务。

5.3 Softmax for N classes5.3 多分类 Softmax

Prob(i)=∑j=1N​ezj​ezi​​logProb(i)=zi​−logj∑​ezj​​
LOG-SOFTMAX GRADIENT (correct class k)Log-softmax 梯度（正确类为 k）
∂zi​∂​logProb(k)=δik​−Prob(i)
Pushes the correct class up by (1 − its probability) and pushes each wrong class down by its probability. (δik​: Kronecker delta.)把正确类往上推 (1 − 其概率)，把每个错误类往下推其概率。（δik​：克罗内克 δ。）

Softmax ≈ the Boltzmann distribution (−zi​ plays the role of energy). Sigmoid is a special case: two classes with a fixed output 0 for class 0 ⇒ Prob(1)=e0+ezez​=1+e−z1​.Softmax 与玻尔兹曼分布对应（−zi​ 相当于能量）。Sigmoid 是特例：两类且类 0 的输出固定为 0 ⇒ Prob(1)=e0+ezez​=1+e−z1​。

EXAMPLE例题
Outputs z=(2,1,0), correct class 1 (the first). ez=(7.389,2.718,1), sum 11.107 ⇒ Prob = (0.665, 0.245, 0.090). Loss =−ln0.665=0.408. Gradient of log Prob(1) w.r.t. z: (1−0.665, −0.245, −0.090) = (0.335, −0.245, −0.090).输出 z=(2,1,0)，正确类为第 1 类。ez=(7.389,2.718,1)，和 11.107 ⇒ 概率 = (0.665, 0.245, 0.090)。损失 =−ln0.665=0.408。log Prob(1) 对 z 的梯度：(1−0.665, −0.245, −0.090) = (0.335, −0.245, −0.090)。

5.4 Weight decay5.4 权重衰减

E=21​i∑​(zi​−ti​)2+2λ​j∑​wj2​

Keeps weights small so units don't saturate; "elastic weights" — like a Hooke's-law spring pulling each weight back to 0. λ is chosen empirically.让权重保持较小，避免单元饱和；称为“弹性权重”——像胡克定律的弹簧把每个权重拉回 0。λ 依经验选择。

5.5 Bayesian inference and MAP5.5 贝叶斯推断与 MAP

P(h∣D)=P(D)P(D∣h)P(h)​posterior∝likelihood×prior​
WEIGHT DECAY = MAP WITH GAUSSIAN PRIOR权重衰减 = 高斯先验下的 MAP
Prior P(w)=∏j​2π​σ0​1​e−wj2​/2σ02​, Gaussian noise σ:先验 P(w)=∏j​2π​σ0​1​e−wj2​/2σ02​，高斯噪声 σ：
logP(w∣t)=−2σ21​i∑​(zi​−ti​)2−2σ02​1​j∑​wj2​+const​
wMAP​=argwmin​ 21​i∑​(zi​−ti​)2+2λ​j∑​wj2​λ=σ2/σ02​​
SAMPLE-EXAM SHORT ANSWER: ML vs BAYESIAN INFERENCE (3 marks)样卷简答：最大似然 vs 贝叶斯推断（3 分）
Maximum likelihood chooses the hypothesis (weights) h that maximises P(D∣h), the probability of the observed targets given the hypothesis; it uses no prior knowledge, and with Gaussian noise it reduces to minimising SSE (Bernoulli ⇒ cross-entropy). Bayesian inference treats the hypothesis itself as uncertain: it combines a prior P(h) with the likelihood to obtain the posterior P(h∣D)∝P(D∣h)P(h). One can then average predictions over the posterior, or take its maximum (MAP estimation). With a Gaussian prior on the weights, MAP = ML + a weight-decay penalty 2λ​∑w2, λ=σ2/σ02​. So Bayesian inference expresses a preference (e.g. for small weights / simple hypotheses) and reduces overfitting when data are scarce. 最大似然选择使 P(D∣h)（给定假设时观测到目标的概率）最大的假设（权重）h；不使用先验知识，在高斯噪声下等价于最小化平方误差（伯努利 ⇒ 交叉熵）。贝叶斯推断把假设本身视为不确定的：把先验 P(h) 与似然结合得到后验 P(h∣D)∝P(D∣h)P(h)，然后可以在后验上对预测取平均，或取后验最大值（MAP 估计）。若对权重取高斯先验，MAP = ML + 权重衰减惩罚 2λ​∑w2，λ=σ2/σ02​。因此贝叶斯推断表达了偏好（如偏好小权重/简单假设），在数据少时可减少过拟合。

5.6 Second-order methods5.6 二阶方法

Use ∂2E/∂wi​∂wj​: conjugate gradients (approximate the landscape by a paraboloid and jump to its minimum), natural gradients (Amari 1995; information-geometry rescaling). Rarely used in deep learning because the number of weights is huge (Hessian is n2); Adam gives similar benefits cheaply.利用 ∂2E/∂wi​∂wj​：共轭梯度（用抛物面近似地形并跳到其最低点）、自然梯度（Amari 1995，信息几何重标度）。深度学习中很少使用，因为权重数巨大（Hessian 有 n2 项）；Adam 能以低成本带来类似好处。

Why does cross-entropy suit unbalanced classification better than SSE?为什么交叉熵比平方误差更适合不平衡分类？

  1. It is bounded between 0 and 1 per item每个样本的损失介于 0 和 1 之间
  2. It ignores outliers它忽略离群点
  3. It needs fewer parameters它需要更少参数

Why are second-order methods (Hessian-based) rarely used in deep learning?为什么深度学习很少用二阶（基于 Hessian）方法？

  1. The number of weights is huge, so second derivatives over all pairs are too expensive权重数巨大，所有权重对的二阶导代价太高
  2. They only work for linear models只适用于线性模型
  3. They always diverge总会发散

6Hidden unit dynamics: geometry, depth & vanishing gradients隐藏单元动力学：几何、深度与梯度消失

Slides: 3b Dynamics对应讲义：3b Dynamics

🎯 Draw and read "hidden unit space" diagrams (an exam diagram question); know encoder tasks; explain weight-space symmetry, controlled nonlinearity, why deep nets need more than 2 layers (twin spirals), and the vanishing/exploding gradient problem and its remedies.🎯 会画/读“隐藏单元空间”图（考试图形题）；了解编码器任务；能解释权重空间对称、受控非线性、为何需要多于两层（双螺旋）以及梯度消失/爆炸及其对策。

6.1 Encoder networks and hidden-unit space6.1 编码器网络与隐藏单元空间

An N–M–N encoder learns the identity mapping on one-hot inputs through a bottleneck of M < N hidden units. It is used to study hidden representations (and is the ancestor of autoencoders).N–M–N 编码器通过 M < N 个隐藏单元的瓶颈，学习对独热输入的恒等映射。用来研究隐藏层表示（也是自编码器的前身）。

HOW TO DRAW HIDDEN-UNIT SPACE如何画隐藏单元空间图
  • Axes = activations of the hidden units (2 hidden units ⇒ a 2-D plot; tanh ⇒ square [−1,1]²).坐标轴 = 各隐藏单元的激活值（2 个隐藏单元 ⇒ 二维图；tanh ⇒ 方块 [−1,1]²）。
  • Each input pattern ⇒ a point (its hidden activation vector). For one-hot inputs this point is determined by that input's input-to-hidden weights.每个输入模式 ⇒ 一个点（其隐藏激活向量）。对独热输入，这个点由该输入单元到隐藏层的权重决定。
  • Each output unit ⇒ a line v1​h1​+v2​h2​+c=0 (its hidden-to-output weights), dividing the space into the side where that output is > ½ and the side where it is < ½.每个输出单元 ⇒ 一条直线 v1​h1​+v2​h2​+c=0（其隐藏到输出的权重），把空间分成该输出 > ½ 与 < ½ 的两侧。
  • A diagram is correct iff, for every output, the points whose target is 1 lie on the > ½ side and all others on the < ½ side.图正确 ⇔ 对每个输出，目标为 1 的点都在 > ½ 一侧，其余都在 < ½ 一侧。
SAMPLE-EXAM DIAGRAM QUESTION, SOLVED BY REASONING (6–2–4 network)样卷图形题的推理方法（6–2–4 网络）
Targets: item1 0001, item2 0011, item3 0100, item4 1010, item5 1011, item6 1110. For each output read the column of 1s:目标：item1 0001、item2 0011、item3 0100、item4 1010、item5 1011、item6 1110。对每个输出读出值为 1 的那一列：
  • output 1 = 1 for items {4,5,6}输出 1 = 1 的样本 {4,5,6}
  • output 2 = 1 for {3,6}输出 2 = 1：{3,6}
  • output 3 = 1 for {2,4,5,6}输出 3 = 1：{2,4,5,6}
  • output 4 = 1 for {1,2,5}输出 4 = 1：{1,2,5}
Check each candidate diagram: every line must have exactly that set of points on its "> ½" side. Eliminate any diagram where some set is on the wrong side or not separable by that line.逐个检查候选图：每条线的“> ½”一侧必须恰好是对应集合。只要有一条线分错，就排除该图。

6.2 Hinton diagrams, symmetry and controlled nonlinearity6.2 Hinton 图、对称性与受控非线性

  • Hinton diagrams visualise weights as squares: size = magnitude, white = positive, black = negative (e.g. ALVINN's hidden units, face-direction networks).Hinton 图用方块可视化权重：大小 = 绝对值，白 = 正，黑 = 负（如 ALVINN 的隐藏单元、人脸朝向网络）。
  • Weight-space symmetry: swapping two hidden nodes, or flipping the sign of all incoming and outgoing weights of a node (symmetric transfer function such as tanh), gives the same function. Hidden nodes with identical initial weights would never separate ⇒ random initialisation is needed; in practice nodes first do similar jobs, then specialise.权重空间对称：交换两个隐藏节点，或把某节点所有输入、输出权重同时变号（对 tanh 等对称函数），得到的函数相同。初始权重完全相同的隐藏节点永远不会分化 ⇒ 必须随机初始化；实践中各节点先做相似工作，然后逐渐分工。
  • Controlled nonlinearity: small weights ⇒ each layer ≈ linear, so the whole net ≈ linear; large weights ⇒ transfer function ≈ step, computation becomes "digital" and learning very slow; typical weights ⇒ nearly linear with a limited, useful degree of nonlinearity.受控非线性：权重很小 ⇒ 每层近似线性，整个网络近似线性；权重很大 ⇒ 传递函数接近阶跃，计算变“数字化”，学习非常慢；典型权重 ⇒ 接近线性但带有有限且有用的非线性。

6.3 Limits of 2-layer nets: twin spirals6.3 两层网络的局限：双螺旋

The twin spirals task is very hard for a 2-layer network but learnable with 3 layers: the first hidden layer learns linearly separable features (half-planes), the second combines them into more complex features (curved regions). Learning rate and initial weights must be small; Adam helps.双螺旋任务对两层网络非常难，但三层网络可以学会：第一隐藏层学线性可分的特征（半平面），第二隐藏层把它们组合成更复杂的特征（弯曲区域）。学习率和初始权重须小；Adam 有帮助。

6.4 Vanishing and exploding gradients6.4 梯度消失与梯度爆炸

In deep nets, the backpropagated differential is multiplied by (weight × g′) at every layer:在深层网络中，反向传播的微分在每一层都要乘以（权重 × g′）：

  • Small weights ⇒ differentials shrink layer by layer ⇒ early layers barely learn (vanishing). Sigmoid makes it worse: σ′≤0.25.权重小 ⇒ 微分逐层缩小 ⇒ 前面层几乎学不动（梯度消失）。sigmoid 更糟：σ′≤0.25。
  • Large weights ⇒ activations saturate at extreme values; differentials can get multiplied repeatedly where the transfer function is steep and blow up (exploding).权重大 ⇒ 激活饱和到极端值；在传递函数陡峭处微分被反复放大而爆炸（梯度爆炸）。
REMEDIES (and where they are covered)对策（及对应章节）
new activation functions (ReLU, leaky ReLU) · careful weight initialisation (§8) · batch normalisation (§8) · skip connections / ResNets (§8) · LSTM for recurrent nets (§9).新的激活函数（ReLU、Leaky ReLU）· 谨慎的权重初始化（§8）· 批归一化（§8）· 跳跃连接/残差网络（§8）· 循环网络用 LSTM（§9）。

Sigmoid and tanh were traditional for 2-layer nets but suffer vanishing gradients when deep. ReLU is popular for deep (incl. convolutional) nets: its derivative is either 0 or 1, so gradients don't shrink through active units. Leaky ReLU gives a small slope for negative inputs so units never fully "die".sigmoid 和 tanh 是两层网络的传统选择，但在深层网络中会梯度消失。ReLU 在深层（包括卷积）网络中流行：导数为 0 或 1，经过激活单元时梯度不会缩小。Leaky ReLU 对负输入给一个小斜率，使单元不会完全“死亡”。

Why must hidden units start with different (random) weights?为什么隐藏单元必须以不同的（随机）权重开始？

  1. Units with identical weights receive identical gradients and would never separate权重相同的单元得到相同的梯度，永远不会分化
  2. To make the network linear为了让网络线性
  3. Because ReLU requires negative weights因为 ReLU 需要负权重
  4. To guarantee a global minimum为了保证全局最小
Symmetry breaking.打破对称性。

When all weights are very large, a sigmoid network…当所有权重都很大时，sigmoid 网络……

  1. behaves almost linearly近似线性
  2. learns faster学得更快
  3. has no local minima没有局部极小
  4. behaves like step units: computation becomes digital and learning very slow像阶跃单元：计算变数字化、学习非常慢
Saturated units have g′≈0.饱和单元的 g′≈0。

In a 3-layer network solving twin spirals, the first hidden layer mainly learns…用三层网络解双螺旋时，第一隐藏层主要学到……

  1. the full spiral shape完整的螺旋形状
  2. random noise随机噪声
  3. linearly separable features (half-planes), which the second layer combines线性可分特征（半平面），再由第二层组合
  4. the output classes directly直接学输出类别
Each first-layer unit is a single neuron, so its region is bounded by a line.第一层每个单元都是单个神经元，其区域由一条直线界定。

Why do ReLUs reduce the vanishing gradient problem?为什么 ReLU 能缓解梯度消失？

  1. They are bounded between 0 and 1输出限制在 0 到 1
  2. Their derivative is 1 for active units, so gradients aren't repeatedly scaled down激活单元的导数为 1，梯度不会被反复缩小
  3. They have no parameters没有参数
  4. They make the network linear让网络变成线性
Sigmoid's derivative ≤ 0.25 shrinks gradients at each layer; ReLU's is 0 or 1.sigmoid 导数 ≤ 0.25 会逐层缩小梯度；ReLU 导数为 0 或 1。

Short answer. List four techniques that help train very deep networks despite vanishing/exploding gradients, with one sentence each.简答。列出四种帮助训练极深网络（应对梯度消失/爆炸）的技术，每种一句话说明。

(1) ReLU-type activations: derivative 0/1, so active paths don't shrink gradients. (2) Weight initialisation with GnVar[w]≈1 per layer (e.g. He init for ReLU) so activations and differentials neither vanish nor explode. (3) Batch normalisation: re-centres/re-scales activations per minibatch, keeping them in a healthy range. (4) Skip (residual) connections: the identity path carries signal and gradient directly across layers. (Also LSTM gating for recurrent nets.)(1) ReLU 类激活：导数为 0/1，激活通路上梯度不缩小。(2) 权重初始化使每层 GnVar[w]≈1（如 ReLU 用 He 初始化），激活与微分既不消失也不爆炸。(3) 批归一化：按小批量重新中心化/缩放激活，使其保持在健康范围。(4) 跳跃（残差）连接：恒等通路把信号和梯度直接跨层传递。（循环网络还可用 LSTM 门控。）

7Convolutional neural networks: convolution, padding, stride, pooling卷积神经网络：卷积、填充、步长、池化

Slides: 4a Convolution对应讲义：4a Convolution

🎯 Explain weight sharing; compute output size, weights per filter, neurons, connections and independent parameters (the sample exam's numerical question) — with and without padding/stride; compute pooling output sizes.🎯 解释权值共享；计算输出尺寸、每个滤波器的权重数、神经元数、连接数与独立参数数（样卷数值题）——含/不含填充与步长；计算池化输出尺寸。

7.1 Why convolution?7.1 为什么用卷积？

To classify an image (bird, sunset, dog…), features such as feather, eye or beak that are useful in one part of the image are probably useful in other parts too. A convolution layer exploits this by applying the same weights to every location (weight sharing), giving shift-invariant features with far fewer parameters than a fully connected layer. Inspired by Hubel & Wiesel's visual cortex cells (oriented-line detectors).给图像分类（鸟、日落、狗…）时，在图像某处有用的特征（羽毛、眼睛、喙）很可能在别处也有用。卷积层利用这一点，在每个位置使用同一组权重（权值共享），得到平移不变的特征，参数远少于全连接层。灵感来自 Hubel & Wiesel 的视觉皮层细胞（方向线条检测器）。

COMPONENTS OF A CNNCNN 的组成
Convolution layers extract shift-invariant features · Pooling/subsampling layers combine several units into one (usually halving each dimension) · Fully connected layers collect spatially diffuse information · Output layer chooses between classes (softmax).卷积层提取平移不变特征 · 池化/下采样层把多个单元合成一个（通常每个方向减半）· 全连接层汇集空间上分散的信息 · 输出层在类别间选择（softmax）。

7.2 The convolution operator7.2 卷积运算

s(t)=(x∗w)(t)=∫x(a)w(t−a)daS(j,k)=(K∗I)(j,k)=m∑​n∑​K(m,n)I(j+m,k+n)​

(Theoreticians write I(j−m,k−n) so the operator is commutative; the "+" version — strictly correlation — is easier computationally.) For a J×K image with L channels and an M×N filter i:（理论上写成 I(j−m,k−n) 使运算可交换；“+”版本——严格说是相关——计算更方便。）对 J×K、L 通道的图像和 M×N 的第 i 个滤波器：

Zj,ki​=g(bi+l∑​m=0∑M−1​n=0∑N−1​Kl,m,ni​Vj+m,k+nl​)

7.3 Size and parameter formulas (memorise!)7.3 尺寸与参数公式（必背！）

THE FOUR NUMBERS THE EXAM ASKS FOR考试要的四个数
Input J×K×L, F filters of size M×N, stride s, zero padding P:输入 J×K×L，F 个 M×N 滤波器，步长 s，零填充 P：
output width=1+sJ+2P−M​output height=1+sK+2P−N​​
  • Weights per filter (incl. bias) = 1+L×M×N每个滤波器的权重（含偏置） = 1+L×M×N
  • Neurons in layer = width × height × F该层神经元数 = 宽 × 高 × F
  • Connections into the layer = neurons × weights-per-filter (each neuron has its own copy of the connections)进入该层的连接数 = 神经元数 × 每滤波器权重数（每个神经元各有一套连接）
  • Independent parameters = F × weights-per-filter (sharing!)独立参数数 = F × 每滤波器权重数（因为权值共享！）
Pooling with width Fp​, stride s: next layer (1+sJ−Fp​​)×(1+sK−Fp​​); pooling has no weights.池化宽 Fp​、步长 s：下一层 (1+sJ−Fp​​)×(1+sK−Fp​​)；池化没有权重。
LECTURE EXAMPLES讲义例题

LeNet conv1: 32×32 greyscale, 6 filters 5×5, no padding, stride 1.32×32 灰度，6 个 5×5 滤波器，无填充，步长 1。 Width宽 = 32+1−5 = 28. weights/filter每滤波器权重 = 1+5×5×1 = 26; neurons神经元 = 28×28×6 = 4704; connections连接 = 4704×26 = 122,304; parameters参数 = 6×26 = 156.

AlexNet conv1: 224×224×3, P = 2, 96 filters 11×11, s = 4.224×224×3，P = 2，96 个 11×11 滤波器，s = 4。 Width宽 = 1+(224+4−11)/4 = 55. weights/filter每滤波器权重 = 1+11×11×3 = 364; neurons神经元 = 55×55×96 = 290,400; connections连接 = 290,400×364 = 105,705,600; parameters参数 = 96×364 = 34,944.

Overlapping max pooling on AlexNet's 55×55 with F = 3, s = 2: 1+(55−3)/2 = 27 → 27×27.AlexNet 55×55 上做重叠最大池化（F = 3，s = 2）：1+(55−3)/2 = 27 → 27×27。

LeNet on MNIST pipeline: 32×32 → conv 5×5 → 28×28 → subsample → 14×14 → conv 5×5 → 10×10 → subsample → 5×5 → two fully connected layers → 10 outputs.LeNet 识别 MNIST 流程：32×32 → 5×5 卷积 → 28×28 → 下采样 → 14×14 → 5×5 卷积 → 10×10 → 下采样 → 5×5 → 两层全连接 → 10 个输出。

7.4 Pooling, zero padding and stride — intuition7.4 池化、零填充与步长的直观理解

  • Zero padding: treat off-edge inputs as 0; with P=(M−1)/2 and stride 1 the output is the same size as the input.零填充：把图像边缘外的输入视为 0；当 P=(M−1)/2、步长 1 时，输出与输入尺寸相同。
  • Stride s>1: move the filter s pixels at a time; j takes values 0,s,2s,…,J+2P−M; the number of free parameters is unchanged (1+LMN per filter).步长 s>1：滤波器每次移动 s 个像素；j 取 0,s,2s,…,J+2P−M；自由参数数不变（每滤波器 1+LMN）。
  • Learned filters: first layer ≈ edges/Gabor-like, deeper layers ≈ parts and objects.学到的滤波器：第一层像边缘/Gabor，越深越像部件和物体。
AlexNet (2012) in briefAlexNet（2012）要点
5 conv + 3 fully connected layers; max pooling with overlapping stride; softmax over 1000 classes; 2 parallel GPUs interacting only at certain layers.5 个卷积层 + 3 个全连接层；重叠步长的最大池化；1000 类 softmax；两块 GPU 并行，只在某些层交互。

1+(33+2−3)/2 = 17 → 17×17×10; params参数 = 10×(1+27) = 280.

Max pooling with width 2 and stride 2 is applied to a 28×28×6 feature map. The result has…对 28×28×6 的特征图做宽 2、步长 2 的最大池化，结果为……

Why does a convolutional layer have far fewer independent parameters than its number of connections?为什么卷积层的独立参数数远少于连接数？

  1. The same filter weights are shared across all spatial positions同一组滤波器权重在所有空间位置共享
  2. Pooling removes most connections池化去掉了大部分连接
  3. Biases are not counted偏置不计入
  4. Zero padding sets weights to zero零填充把权重设为零
Connections = neurons × weights per filter; parameters = filters × weights per filter.连接 = 神经元数 × 每滤波器权重；参数 = 滤波器数 × 每滤波器权重。

A 5×5 filter, stride 1. Which zero padding keeps a 32×32 input at 32×32?5×5 滤波器、步长 1。多少零填充可使 32×32 输入保持 32×32 输出？

  1. 0
  2. 1
  3. 4
  4. 2
1+(32+2P−5)/1 = 32 ⇒ P = 2 = (M−1)/2.

Which component of a CNN collects spatially diffuse information before classification?CNN 中哪个组件在分类前汇集空间上分散的信息？

  1. Convolution layer卷积层
  2. Fully connected layer全连接层
  3. Zero padding零填充
  4. Max pooling最大池化
Conv layers are local; FC layers see everything.卷积层是局部的；全连接层看到全部。

Numerical. A second conv layer receives 14×14×6 and has 16 filters of 5×5 (no padding, stride 1). Output size, weights per filter, parameters?数值题。第二个卷积层输入 14×14×6，有 16 个 5×5 滤波器（无填充、步长 1）。输出尺寸、每滤波器权重、参数数？

10×10×16; 1+5×5×6 = 151; 16×151 = 2,416. (Note the filter spans all 6 input channels.)（注意滤波器跨越全部 6 个输入通道。）

8.1 Datasets, tasks, architectures8.1 数据集、任务与结构

Dataset数据集Images图像Resolution分辨率Classes类别
MNIST60,000 (B/W digits)28×2810
CIFAR-1050,000 colour32×3210

Tasks: classification, object detection, segmentation, style transfer, image/art generation, captioning. ImageNet winners: AlexNet 8 layers (2012) → VGG 19 (2014) → GoogLeNet 22 (2014) → ResNet 152 (2015).任务：分类、目标检测、分割、风格迁移、图像/艺术生成、图像描述。ImageNet 冠军：AlexNet 8 层（2012）→ VGG 19 层（2014）→ GoogLeNet 22 层（2014）→ ResNet 152 层（2015）。

AlexNet: SIZE & ENHANCEMENTSAlexNet：规模与改进
650K neurons, 630M connections, 60M parameters — more parameters than images ⇒ danger of overfitting. Enhancements: ReLUs; overlapping pooling (width 3, stride 2); SGD with momentum and weight decay; data augmentation; 50% dropout in the fully connected layers. Augmentation: ten 224×224 patches cropped from each image + their horizontal reflections; at test time average predictions over the 10 patches; plus changes to RGB intensities. First-layer kernels resemble Gabor filters (GPU-1 colour-agnostic, GPU-2 colour-specific). 65 万神经元、6.3 亿连接、6000 万参数——参数比图像还多 ⇒ 有过拟合风险。改进：ReLU；重叠池化（宽 3、步长 2）；带动量和权重衰减的 SGD；数据增强；全连接层 50% dropout。增强方式：每张图裁出 10 个 224×224 块并加入水平翻转；测试时对这 10 块的预测取平均；另外改变 RGB 强度。第一层卷积核类似 Gabor 滤波器（GPU-1 与颜色无关，GPU-2 与颜色相关）。
RULE OF THUMB FOR DEPTH深度经验法则
> 10 layers → need careful weight initialisation and batch normalisation; > 30 layers → skip connections; > 100 layers → identity skip connections.> 10 层 → 需要谨慎的权重初始化和批归一化；> 30 层 → 跳跃连接；> 100 层 → 恒等跳跃连接。

8.2 Weight initialisation (variance argument)8.2 权重初始化（方差分析）

Statistics warm-up: one coin toss (heads = 1) has mean 0.5, variance 0.25, σ = 0.5. 100 tosses: mean 50, variance 25, σ = 5. 10,000 tosses: mean 5000, σ = 50. Variances of independent variables add. If wk​,xk​ are independent with zero mean and y=∑k=1n​wk​xk​, then统计热身：抛一次硬币（正面 = 1）均值 0.5、方差 0.25、σ = 0.5。抛 100 次：均值 50、方差 25、σ = 5。抛 10000 次：均值 5000、σ = 50。独立变量的方差相加。若 wk​,xk​ 独立且均值为 0，y=∑k=1n​wk​xk​，则

Var[y]=nVar[w]Var[x]

For layer i with niin​ incoming connections and transfer function g (factor G0​): Var[x(i+1)]≃G0​niin​Var[w(i)]Var[x(i)]. Over D layers:对第 i 层（入连接数 niin​，传递函数因子 G0​）：Var[x(i+1)]≃G0​niin​Var[w(i)]Var[x(i)]。经过 D 层：

Var[z]≃i=1∏D​(G0​niin​Var[w(i)])Var[x]Var[∂x∂​]≃i=1∏D​(G1​niout​Var[w(i)])Var[∂z∂​]​
CONDITION FOR HEALTHY FORWARD & BACKWARD PROPAGATION前向与反向传播都健康的条件
Each factor in the product should be ≈ 1, otherwise activations vanish/saturate and differentials decay/explode exponentially in D:乘积中每个因子都应 ≈ 1，否则激活会随深度 D 指数级消失/饱和，微分指数级衰减/爆炸：
G0​niin​Var[w(i)]≈1G1​niout​Var[w(i)]≈1​
For ReLU, G0​=G1​=21​ ⇒ Var[w]=2/n ("He" initialisation). Empirically a 30-layer ReLU net with G=21​ learns, while G=1 fails to learn at all.对 ReLU，G0​=G1​=21​ ⇒ Var[w]=2/n（“He”初始化）。实验中 30 层 ReLU 网络取 G=21​ 能学习，而取 G=1 完全学不动。

8.3 Batch normalisation8.3 批归一化

x^k(i)​=Var[xk(i)​]​xk(i)​−Mean[xk(i)​]​yk(i)​=βk(i)​+γk(i)​x^k(i)​​

Mean/variance computed over the minibatch for each node. β,γ are extra per-node parameters trained by backprop (so the network can undo the normalisation if useful). After training, Mean and Var are pre-computed on the whole training set or taken from running averages.对每个节点，均值/方差在小批量上计算。β,γ 是每个节点额外的参数，由反向传播训练（必要时网络可以撤销归一化）。训练结束后，均值和方差用整个训练集预先计算，或用滑动平均。

8.4 Residual networks and dense networks8.4 残差网络与稠密网络

Going deeper problem: simply stacking more layers can give higher training error (and test error) — an optimisation problem, not overfitting. Residual idea: add a skip connection that bypasses two layers and is added to their output: H(x)=F(x)+x.加深的问题：单纯堆叠更多层会导致训练误差更高（测试误差也高）——这是优化问题，而非过拟合。残差思想：加一条绕过两层的跳跃连接，并加到它们的输出上：H(x)=F(x)+x。

The earlier layers try to do the "whole" job; F(x) is a residual correction (extra detail the previous layers could not compute), and the gradient flows straight back through the "+". With > 100 layers, apply the ReLU before the addition so the shortcut is a pure identity skip connection. With skip connections, both training and test error drop as more layers are added. DenseNets: within a densely connected block, each layer receives shortcut connections from all preceding layers (features are concatenated).前面的层尽量完成“整个”任务；F(x) 是残差修正（前面层算不出的额外细节），梯度通过“+”直接回传。超过 100 层时，把 ReLU 放在相加之前，使捷径成为纯恒等跳跃连接。有了跳跃连接，层数增加时训练和测试误差都会下降。DenseNet：在稠密块内，每一层都从所有前面的层获得捷径连接（特征拼接）。

8.5 Texture synthesis & neural style transfer8.5 纹理合成与神经风格迁移

  1. Pre-train a CNN on ImageNet (VGG-19).在 ImageNet 上预训练 CNN（VGG-19）。
  2. Pass the texture image through; Fikl​ = activation of filter i at position k in layer l.把纹理图输入网络；Fikl​ = 第 l 层第 i 个滤波器在位置 k 的激活。
  3. Gram matrix Gijl​=∑k​Fikl​Fjkl​ — correlations between feature maps, summed over positions (so spatial layout is discarded, "style" kept).Gram 矩阵 Gijl​=∑k​Fikl​Fjkl​——各特征图之间的相关性，对位置求和（丢弃空间布局，保留“风格”）。
  4. Feed a (random) image, compute L2 distance between Gram matrices, backprop to the image pixels, update the image, repeat.输入一张（随机）图像，计算两组 Gram 矩阵的 L2 距离，反向传播到图像像素，更新图像，重复。
Estyle​=l=0∑L​4Nl2​Ml2​wl​​i,j∑​(Gijl​−Aijl​)2Etotal​=αEcontent​+βEstyle​Econtent​=21​i,k∑​∥Fikl​(x)−Fikl​(xc​)∥2​

  1. 0.02
  2. 0.04
  3. 0.2
  4. 1/50²
GnVar[w]=1, G=21​⇒Var[w]=2/50=0.04 (std 0.2).（标准差 0.2）。

In batch normalisation, which quantities are learned by backpropagation?批归一化中哪些量由反向传播学习？

  1. the minibatch mean and variance小批量均值和方差
  2. nothing — it is a fixed transform没有——它是固定变换
  3. the shift β and scale γ for each node每个节点的平移 β 和缩放 γ
  4. the batch size批大小
Mean/Var are computed from data (running averages at test time); β, γ are trainable.均值/方差由数据计算（测试时用滑动平均）；β、γ 可训练。

Stacking more plain layers on a deep CNN increased its training error. This shows…在深层 CNN 上堆叠更多普通层后，训练误差反而上升。这说明……

  1. an optimisation difficulty (not overfitting), which residual connections address优化困难（而非过拟合），可用残差连接解决
  2. overfitting, which dropout addresses过拟合，可用 dropout 解决
  3. the dataset is too large数据集太大
  4. pooling is too aggressive池化太激进
Overfitting would lower training error while raising test error.过拟合会让训练误差降低而测试误差升高。

Why does the style loss use Gram matrices rather than the feature maps themselves?为什么风格损失用 Gram 矩阵而不是特征图本身？

  1. Gram matrices are smaller to store on the GPUGram 矩阵在 GPU 上更省空间
  2. They preserve exact object positions保留物体的精确位置
  3. They make the network linear让网络变成线性
  4. Summing feature correlations over all positions discards spatial layout but keeps texture/style statistics对所有位置的特征相关性求和，丢弃空间布局但保留纹理/风格统计
Content is matched via feature maps directly; style via their correlations.内容直接用特征图匹配；风格用其相关性匹配。

Which was NOT one of AlexNet's enhancements?以下哪项不是 AlexNet 的改进？

  1. ReLU activationsReLU 激活
  2. Identity skip connections恒等跳跃连接
  3. Dropout in fully connected layers全连接层 dropout
  4. Overlapping max pooling重叠最大池化
Skip connections came with ResNet (2015).跳跃连接来自 ResNet（2015）。

Toss a fair coin 400 times and count heads. Standard deviation?公平硬币抛 400 次，正面次数的标准差？

  1. 4
  2. 20
  3. 10
  4. 100
Var=400×0.25=100⇒σ=10.

Short answer (3 marks). Explain what a residual (skip) connection is and why it allows much deeper networks to be trained.简答（3 分）。解释什么是残差（跳跃）连接，以及它为何能训练更深的网络。

A residual block computes H(x)=F(x)+x: the input bypasses two (or more) layers and is added to their output. (1) The stacked layers only need to learn a residual correction F(x) to what earlier layers already computed; if extra layers aren't useful they can learn F≈0 and the block becomes the identity, so adding depth cannot make training worse. (2) In backprop, the "+x" path gives the gradient a direct route (derivative 1) back to earlier layers, so it doesn't vanish through many multiplications. Result: training and test error keep falling with depth (152-layer ResNet); with > 100 layers the ReLU is applied before the addition (identity skip connection) so the shortcut is a pure identity.残差块计算 H(x)=F(x)+x：输入绕过两层（或更多层）后加到其输出上。(1) 堆叠层只需学习对前面结果的残差修正 F(x)；若额外层没用，可以学到 F≈0，该块变成恒等映射，所以加深不会让训练变差。(2) 反向传播中，“+x”通路为梯度提供直达前层的路径（导数为 1），不会因多次相乘而消失。结果：误差随深度增加持续下降（152 层 ResNet）；超过 100 层时把 ReLU 放在相加之前（恒等跳跃连接），使捷径是纯恒等映射。
