9.1 Sequence tasks and the backbone/head view9.1 序列任务与“主干/头部”视角

Pattern模式Example例子
one → onenot a sequence: image → "cat" (feed-forward net)非序列：图像 → “猫”（前馈网络）
many → oneclassify the sequence: movie review → positive/negative对整个序列分类：影评 → 正面/负面
many → many, aligned多 → 多，对齐label every element: names (PER/LOC tagging), next word, letter → sound给每个元素打标签：人名地名标注、下一个词、字母 → 发音
many → many, unaligned多 → 多，不对齐read everything, then write: translation (3 English words → 2 French)先读完再写：翻译（3 个英文词 → 2 个法文词）
past → future过去 → 未来forecast: last 30 days of share price → next 7预测：过去 30 天股价 → 未来 7 天
one → manygenerate a sequence (e.g. captioning)生成序列（如图像描述）

General structure: input (text, audio frames, DNA…) turned into vectors → backbone (NETtalk MLP, RNN, LSTM, GRU, BiRNN, Transformer) computes a representation h → head (e.g. linear + softmax) turns h into task scores y^​. Same backbone, many tasks: swap the head and the training targets.一般结构：输入（文本、音频帧、DNA…）转成向量 → 主干（NETtalk MLP、RNN、LSTM、GRU、双向 RNN、Transformer）计算表示 h → 头部（如线性 + softmax）把 h 变成任务分数 y^​。同一个主干、多种任务：换掉头部和训练目标即可。

9.2 Turning text into vectors: tokens, embeddings, BPE9.2 把文本变成向量：词元、嵌入、BPE

A network reads numbers: text → tokens → token IDs (index in vocabulary) → embedding vectors (a learned lookup table). Vocabulary size is a trade-off:网络读的是数字：文本 → 词元（token）→ 词元 ID（词表中的序号）→ 嵌入向量（可学习的查找表）。词表大小是一种权衡：

Small (characters/bytes, V = 256)小（字符/字节，V = 256）Large (whole words, V ≈ 3M in word2vec)大（整词，word2vec 中 V ≈ 300 万）
Pros优点never an unknown word; small embedding table不会遇到未知词；嵌入表小short sequences; each token meaningful序列短；每个词元有意义
Cons缺点long sequences (far-apart dependencies)序列长（依赖距离远）huge table; unknown/rare words表巨大；未知/罕见词
BYTE-PAIR ENCODING (BPE) — the middle way used by LLMs字节对编码（BPE）——LLM 采用的折中方案
  1. Start with one token per character (or byte).从每个字符（或字节）一个词元开始。
  2. Merge the most frequent adjacent pair into a new token.把出现最频繁的相邻对合并成新词元。
  3. Repeat until the vocabulary reaches the desired size.重复直到词表达到目标大小。
Toy corpus: low×5, lower×2, newest×6, widest×3. Merges: e+s→es (9×), es+t→est (9×), l+o→lo (7×), lo+w→low (7×)… Frequent words become one token; rare words stay in pieces. LLM APIs charge per token.玩具语料：low×5、lower×2、newest×6、widest×3。合并顺序：e+s→es（9 次）、es+t→est（9 次）、l+o→lo（7 次）、lo+w→low（7 次）……高频词变成一个词元，罕见词保持拆分。LLM API 按词元计费。

Training the backbone: supervised — a person gives the target (e.g. ImageNet labels; expensive); self-supervised — the data gives the target: hide part of the input and predict it (next word for GPT, masked word for BERT which hides 15%, next DNA base for genome models).训练主干：监督——由人给目标（如 ImageNet 标签；昂贵）；自监督——数据自己给目标：遮住一部分输入再预测它（GPT 预测下一个词，BERT 预测被遮的词、遮 15%，基因组模型预测下一个碱基）。

9.3 NETtalk (1986): a fixed window9.3 NETtalk（1986）：固定窗口

NETtalk (Sejnowski & Rosenberg) converts English text to speech: an MLP looks at a fixed window of letters and outputs the phoneme for the middle letter. Toy version: fill the gap with "is"/"are" using a 5-slot window (2 words each side), one-hot words → 10 sigmoid hidden units → softmax(2).NETtalk（Sejnowski & Rosenberg）把英文文本转成语音：MLP 看一个固定窗口内的字母，输出中间字母的音素。玩具版：用 5 格窗口（空位两侧各 2 个词）在空位填 “is/are”，独热词 → 10 个 sigmoid 隐藏单元 → softmax(2)。

WHY IT FAILS为什么会失败
Test 1 "The students ___ ready." ✓. Test 2 "The students who attended the lecture ___ ready." ✗ — the clue "students" is 5 words before the gap, outside the window. Fixes: (1) a bigger window — but there is always a longer sentence, each slot adds weights and the rule must be re-learned for every slot; (2) add a memory carried from step to step → recurrent networks.测试 1 “The students ___ ready.” ✓。测试 2 “The students who attended the lecture ___ ready.” ✗——线索 “students” 在空位前 5 个词，超出窗口。解决：(1) 加大窗口——但总有更长的句子，每加一格就加权重，且规则要在每一格重新学；(2) 加入步与步之间传递的记忆 → 循环神经网络。

9.4 Simple (Elman) RNN9.4 简单（Elman）RNN

Elman (1990): the hidden layer's previous value is copied into context units and fed back in. "RNN" is the general name for any network with such a loop; vanilla RNN, LSTM, GRU and bidirectional RNNs are all RNNs.Elman（1990）：把隐藏层上一时刻的值复制到上下文单元再反馈回来。“RNN”是所有带此类环路网络的统称；普通 RNN、LSTM、GRU、双向 RNN 都属于 RNN。

ELMAN RNNElman RNN
at​=Wxh​xt​+Whh​ht−1​+bh​ht​=tanh(at​)y^​t​=softmax(Why​ht​+by​)​

An RNN can be unrolled into an equivalent feed-forward network with shared weights, trained by backpropagation through time (BPTT). Unlike NETtalk, the memory h can keep the clue "students" across the relative clause.RNN 可以展开成共享权重的等价前馈网络，用沿时间反向传播（BPTT）训练。与 NETtalk 不同，记忆 h 可以把线索 “students” 跨过关系从句保留下来。

TWO WEAKNESSES OF THE SIMPLE RNN简单 RNN 的两个弱点
  1. Early information fades (forward pass): every step multiplies the old memory by Whh​ and squashes it. If ½ is kept per step, "dogs" in "The dogs that chased the cat ___" is down to 1/32 at the gap while the newer "cat" dominates → predicts "is" ✗. Memory decays at least exponentially.早期信息衰减（前向）：每一步旧记忆都要乘 Whh​ 并被压缩。若每步保留 ½，则在 “The dogs that chased the cat ___” 中 “dogs” 到空位时只剩 1/32，较新的 “cat” 占主导 → 预测 “is” ✗。记忆至少按指数衰减。
  2. Vanishing/exploding gradients (backward pass): ∂h2​∂L​=∂h7​∂L​∏t=37​∂ht−1​∂ht​​ — one factor per step. Factors < 1 ⇒ (21​)5=1/32: the link "dogs → are" is barely learned; factors > 1 ⇒ explosion.梯度消失/爆炸（反向）：∂h2​∂L​=∂h7​∂L​∏t=37​∂ht−1​∂ht​​——每步一个因子。因子 < 1 ⇒ (21​)5=1/32：“dogs → are” 的关联几乎学不到；因子 > 1 ⇒ 爆炸。

9.5 LSTM (Hochreiter & Schmidhuber 1997)9.5 LSTM（Hochreiter & Schmidhuber 1997）

Long Short-Term Memory adds a separate cell ct​ guarded by three gates (forget gate added by Gers et al. 2000). Gates use σ (0 = block, 1 = pass); new content uses tanh (−1…1).长短期记忆网络增加一个独立的细胞状态 ct​，由三个门守护（遗忘门由 Gers 等于 2000 年加入）。门用 σ（0 = 阻断，1 = 通过）；新内容用 tanh（−1…1）。

LSTM EQUATIONS (one time step)LSTM 方程（单个时间步）
ft​=σ(Wf​[ht−1​,xt​]+bf​)it​=σ(Wi​[ht−1​,xt​]+bi​)gt​=tanh(Wg​[ht−1​,xt​]+bg​)ot​=σ(Wo​[ht−1​,xt​]+bo​)​
ct​=ft​⊙ct−1​+it​⊙gt​ht​=ot​⊙tanh(ct​)​
  • forget f: how much of the old memory to keep (0 at "The" of a new sentence, then 1);遗忘门 f：旧记忆保留多少（新句子开头 “The” 处为 0，之后为 1）；
  • input i: how much new content to write (1 at "dogs" only, so "cat" stays out);输入门 i：写入多少新内容（只在 “dogs” 处为 1，“cat” 不写入）；
  • g: the new content (+0.9 "plural" at "dogs");g：新内容（“dogs” 处 +0.9 表示复数）；
  • output o: how much of the memory to show (1 at the gap) ⇒ h=1⋅tanh(0.9)=0.72 ⇒ "are" ✓.输出门 o：显示多少记忆（空位处为 1）⇒ h=1⋅tanh(0.9)=0.72 ⇒ “are” ✓。
Why gradients survive: along the cell, the backward factor per step is just ft​ (≈ 1 when remembering) instead of repeated multiplication by Whh​ and squashing.梯度为何能保留：沿细胞状态，每步的反向因子只是 ft​（记忆时 ≈ 1），而不是反复乘 Whh​ 再压缩。

What LSTM cells learn to hold (probing examples from the slides): inside/outside a quote and position in the line (Karpathy), a review's sentiment (Radford's "sentiment neuron"), winter snow storage in hydrology (Kratzert), a cube's size in robotics (OpenAI), the subject's number for agreement (Lakretz). Used in Gboard (a small LSTM, 1.4M weights, trained on phones).LSTM 细胞学会保存的内容（讲义中的探测例子）：是否在引号内、在行中的位置（Karpathy），评论的情感（Radford 的“情感神经元”），水文中冬季积雪量（Kratzert），机械手里魔方的大小（OpenAI），主语单复数（Lakretz）。Gboard 输入法使用小型 LSTM（140 万权重，在手机上训练）。

COUNTING WEIGHTS权重计数
Each layer acting on [ht−1​,xt​] has nh​(nh​+nx​)+nh​ weights. Simple RNN: 1 such layer; GRU: 3; LSTM: 4. Example nh​=150, nx​=31: one layer = 150×181+150 = 27,300 ⇒ RNN 27,300, GRU 81,900, LSTM 109,200.每个作用在 [ht−1​,xt​] 上的层有 nh​(nh​+nx​)+nh​ 个权重。简单 RNN：1 个；GRU：3 个；LSTM：4 个。例：nh​=150, nx​=31：一层 = 150×181+150 = 27,300 ⇒ RNN 27,300，GRU 81,900，LSTM 109,200。

LSTM weaknesses: (1) big — 4 layers and 2 memories (4× weights and work per step); (2) one direction — it has only read the past (e.g. "There ___ students…": the clue comes after the gap); (3) still processes one step after another (no parallelism over time).LSTM 的弱点：(1) 大——4 个层、2 份记忆（每步 4 倍权重和计算）；(2) 单向——只读过过去（如 “There ___ students…”，线索在空位之后）；(3) 仍需一步接一步处理（时间上无法并行）。

9.6 GRU (Cho et al. 2014)9.6 GRU（Cho 等 2014）

GRU EQUATIONSGRU 方程
rt​=σ(Wr​[ht−1​,xt​]+br​)zt​=σ(Wz​[ht−1​,xt​]+bz​)gt​=tanh(Wg​[rt​⊙ht−1​,xt​]+bg​)​
ht​=zt​⊙ht−1​+(1−zt​)⊙gt​
update gate z = how much old memory to keep (1 − z = how much new); reset gate r = how much old memory to use when computing the new content.更新门 z = 保留多少旧记忆（1 − z = 写入多少新内容）；重置门 r = 计算新内容时使用多少旧记忆。
LSTMGRU
Memories记忆c (kept) and h (shown)c（保存）与 h（显示）one: h, kept and shown只有 h，既保存又显示
Keep old保留旧的forget gate f遗忘门 fupdate gate z更新门 z
Write new写入新的input gate i (independent)输入门 i（独立）1 − z (tied to z)1 − z（与 z 绑定）
Output输出o⊙tanh(c)all of h (no output gate)整个 h（无输出门）
Weight matrices权重矩阵4 (f, i, g, o)3 (z, r, g)

GRU weaknesses: keep and write are tied (z and 1−z sum to 1), so h is always a mix of old and new, stays within (−1, 1), and cannot count for long (LSTM can keep all with f = 1 and add with i = 1); no output gate to show only part of the memory. In practice results are mixed — GRU is smaller and often similar.GRU 的弱点：保留与写入被绑定（z 与 1−z 之和为 1），所以 h 总是新旧的混合、始终在 (−1, 1) 内，无法长时间计数（LSTM 可以 f = 1 全部保留、i = 1 不断累加）；没有输出门，不能只显示部分记忆。实践中结果互有胜负——GRU 更小、效果常相近。

9.7 Bidirectional RNNs9.7 双向 RNN

Run one RNN forwards and one backwards and concatenate: output at t reads [ht​​,ht​​] (Schuster & Paliwal 1997; BiLSTM Graves & Schmidhuber 2005; BiGRU encoder of Bahdanau 2014). Use when the whole sequence is available and later context matters: tagging ("New York" vs "New cars"), speech phonemes (framewise accuracy 68.5% both ways vs 63.2% forwards), DNA splice sites. Not usable for predicting the next word / real-time generation (the future isn't available).一个 RNN 正向、一个反向运行再拼接：t 时刻输出读取 [ht​​,ht​​]（Schuster & Paliwal 1997；BiLSTM：Graves & Schmidhuber 2005；Bahdanau 2014 的 BiGRU 编码器）。适用于整个序列已知且后文重要的场景：序列标注（“New York” vs “New cars”）、语音音素（双向 68.5% vs 正向 63.2%）、DNA 剪接位点。预测下一个词/实时生成时不能用（未来不可得）。

Practice — Section 9练习 — 第 9 节

(Sample exam) Which architecture has the best chance of learning long-range dependencies?（样卷）哪种结构最有可能学到长程依赖？

  1. Elman networkElman 网络
  2. Feedforward network with sliding window带滑动窗口的前馈网络
  3. Long Short-Term Memory长短期记忆网络（LSTM）
  4. Simple Recurrent Network简单循环网络
Elman net = SRN: gradients vanish. Sliding window: limited view. LSTM's gated cell preserves information and gradient.Elman 网络 = 简单 RNN：梯度消失。滑动窗口：视野有限。LSTM 的门控细胞能保存信息与梯度。

(Sample exam) What are the gates in an LSTM?（样卷）LSTM 有哪些门？

  1. forget, input, update遗忘、输入、更新
  2. input, output, reset输入、输出、重置
  3. input, reset, update输入、重置、更新
  4. forget, input, output遗忘、输入、输出
Reset and update are GRU gates.重置门和更新门属于 GRU。

In the GRU, ht​=zt​⊙ht−1​+(1−zt​)⊙gt​. If zt​=1 for every unit, the GRU…GRU 中 ht​=zt​⊙ht−1​+(1−zt​)⊙gt​。若所有单元 zt​=1，则 GRU……

  1. copies its memory unchanged (ignores the current input)原样复制记忆（忽略当前输入）
  2. replaces its memory with the new content用新内容替换记忆
  3. resets the memory to zero把记忆清零
  4. outputs only the input只输出输入
ht​=ht−1​.

Numerical. An LSTM layer has 10 hidden units and one-hot inputs of size V = 20. How many weights (incl. biases) does it have? How many would a GRU have?数值题。某 LSTM 层有 10 个隐藏单元，输入是大小 V = 20 的独热向量。共有多少权重（含偏置）？GRU 呢？

One layer: 10×(10+20)+10 = 310. LSTM: 4×310 = 1,240. GRU: 3×310 = 930.一个层：10×(10+20)+10 = 310。LSTM：4×310 = 1,240。GRU：3×310 = 930。

In a simple RNN, the backpropagated gradient must pass through 6 time steps, each with factor ∂ht​/∂ht−1​≈0.5. The gradient reaching the first step is about…简单 RNN 中梯度要反向穿过 6 个时间步，每步因子 ∂ht​/∂ht−1​≈0.5。到达第一步的梯度约为原来的……

  1. 0.5
  2. 0.016
  3. 3
  4. 0.083
0.56=1/64≈0.016 — vanishing gradient.梯度消失。

Which task can NOT use a bidirectional RNN in its standard form?哪种任务不能直接使用标准双向 RNN？

  1. Named-entity tagging of a full sentence对整句做命名实体标注
  2. Phoneme labelling of a recorded utterance对录好的语音做音素标注
  3. Next-word prediction on a phone keyboard while typing手机键盘上边打字边预测下一个词
  4. Sentiment classification of a review评论情感分类
The future words do not exist yet.未来的词还不存在。

Machine translation from English to French is which input/output pattern?英译法的机器翻译属于哪种输入/输出模式？

  1. one → many
  2. many → one
  3. many → many, aligned多 → 多，对齐
  4. many → many, unaligned多 → 多，不对齐
Output length differs and words don't correspond one-to-one: read everything, then write.输出长度不同且词不一一对应：先读完再写。

Corpus: "aa ab aa aa ab" (counting pairs inside words only). Starting from characters, which merge does BPE perform first?语料：“aa ab aa aa ab”（只统计词内的相邻对）。BPE 从字符开始，第一步合并哪一对？

  1. a + a → aa
  2. a + b → ab
  3. both at once两个同时
  4. no merge; BPE starts from whole words不合并；BPE 从整词开始
"aa" occurs 3 times, "ab" twice: merge the most frequent pair first.“aa” 出现 3 次，“ab” 2 次：先合并最频繁的一对。

Why does the NETtalk-style network fail on "The students who attended the lecture ___ ready"?NETtalk 式网络为何在 “The students who attended the lecture ___ ready” 上失败？

  1. It uses sigmoid units使用了 sigmoid 单元
  2. The clue "students" lies outside its fixed window线索 “students” 位于其固定窗口之外
  3. The vocabulary is too small词表太小
  4. It has too many hidden units隐藏单元太多
It carries nothing between positions — no memory.它在不同位置之间不传递任何信息——没有记忆。

BERT-style and GPT-style self-supervised training differ mainly in that…BERT 式与 GPT 式自监督训练的主要区别是……

  1. BERT needs human labelsBERT 需要人工标签
  2. GPT hides 15% of words at randomGPT 随机遮住 15% 的词
  3. BERT predicts masked words (15% hidden); GPT predicts the next wordBERT 预测被遮住的词（遮 15%）；GPT 预测下一个词
  4. both predict sentiment都预测情感
In both, the data itself supplies the targets.二者的目标都由数据本身提供。

Short answer (3 marks). Explain how the LSTM cell avoids the two weaknesses of the simple RNN.简答（3 分）。解释 LSTM 细胞如何避免简单 RNN 的两个弱点。

Simple RNN: (1) information fades because h is multiplied by Whh​ and squashed every step; (2) gradients vanish/explode because BPTT multiplies one Jacobian factor per step. LSTM keeps a separate cell ct​=ft​⊙ct−1​+it​⊙gt​ updated additively: the forget gate can stay ≈ 1 so stored information (e.g. "plural") is carried unchanged for many steps, and the input gate can stay ≈ 0 so irrelevant words ("cat") are not written. The output gate shows the memory only when needed. Backwards, the gradient along the cell is multiplied only by ft​ per step (≈ 1 while remembering), giving a "constant error carousel", so long-range dependencies can be learned.简单 RNN：(1) 每步 h 都乘 Whh​ 并被压缩，信息衰减；(2) BPTT 每步乘一个雅可比因子，梯度消失/爆炸。LSTM 维护独立细胞 ct​=ft​⊙ct−1​+it​⊙gt​，以加法更新：遗忘门可保持 ≈ 1，使存入的信息（如“复数”）多步不变；输入门可保持 ≈ 0，不写入无关词（“cat”）；输出门只在需要时显示记忆。反向时沿细胞的梯度每步只乘 ft​（记忆时 ≈ 1），形成“恒定误差传送带”，从而能学习长程依赖。

10Language processing & word vectors: n-grams, co-occurrence, SVD, word2vec语言处理与词向量：n-gram、共现矩阵、SVD、word2vec

Slides: 5c Language Processing / Word Vectors对应讲义：5c Language Processing / Word Vectors

🎯 Explain distributional semantics; build n-gram and co-occurrence models; reduce dimension with SVD; describe word2vec (CBOW vs skip-gram), its cost function and efficient alternatives to softmax (hierarchical softmax, negative sampling, subsampling); solve analogies with vector arithmetic.🎯 解释分布式语义；构建 n-gram 与共现模型；用 SVD 降维；描述 word2vec（CBOW vs Skip-gram）、其代价函数以及 softmax 的高效替代（层次 softmax、负采样、高频词下采样）；用向量运算解类比题。

10.1 From dictionaries to statistics10.1 从词典到统计

Synonyms, antonyms and taxonomies (penguin is-a bird…) need human effort, are incomplete, force discrete choices and lose nuance ("king" and "queen" are similar in some attributes, opposite in others). Instead, extract statistics automatically from text. Counting word frequencies per document gives document vectors (useful for classification; maybe binary "occurs/doesn't" to avoid skew).同义词、反义词、分类体系（企鹅 is-a 鸟…）需要人工、不完整、只能离散选择且丢失细微差别（“king”和“queen”在某些属性上相似、在另一些上相反）。改为从文本中自动提取统计信息。统计每篇文档的词频得到文档向量（可用于分类；也可用 0/1 表示是否出现以避免偏斜）。

N-GRAM MODELN-gram 模型
Count consecutive word pairs; normalise each row to sum to 1 ⇒ prob(wj​∣wi​), a predictive 1-gram model (captures "there was", "man who", "lived together"…). Generalise to bigram, trigram… n-gram by conditioning on the n preceding words; aggregate over a large corpus so rare words don't dominate; large vocabularies need tricks to avoid exponential memory. Sampling from it gives locally plausible but globally meaningless text ("Rashly – Good night is very liberal…").统计相邻词对；把每行归一化为和 1 ⇒ prob(wj​∣wi​)，即预测性的 1-gram 模型（能捕捉 “there was”、“man who”、“lived together”…）。以前 n 个词为条件可推广到 bigram、trigram……n-gram；需在大语料上汇总，免得罕见词主导；词表大时需要技巧避免内存指数增长。从中采样得到局部通顺但整体无意义的文本。

Co-occurrence matrix: rows = words, columns = words appearing within an n-word window (not necessarily adjacent). Larger windows reveal topical groups (cat–caught–mouse, walked–mile, little–house). Common words dominate → sample them less often. Each row is a word vector, but its dimension = vocabulary size (~10⁵) — reduce it!共现矩阵：行 = 词，列 = 在 n 词窗口内出现的词（不必相邻）。窗口越大越能揭示主题类词组（cat–caught–mouse、walked–mile、little–house）。常见词会主导 → 降低其采样频率。每行是一个词向量，但维度 = 词表大小（~10⁵）——需要降维！

"You shall know a word by the company it keeps" (Firth 1957). Goal of word embeddings: nearby vectors ⇔ words used in similar contexts.“观其伴，知其词”（Firth 1957）。词嵌入的目标：向量相近 ⇔ 词出现在相似语境中。

10.2 Singular value decomposition10.2 奇异值分解

X(L×M)​=USVTs1​≥s2​≥⋯≥0​

U, V have orthonormal columns; S is diagonal. Truncate to rank N: U~L×N​S~V~T; the k-th row of U~ is an N-dimensional vector for the k-th word (Latent Semantic Analysis). Cost ∝ LM2 — expensive and not incremental. Differences from eigen-decomposition: eigenvalues may be negative or complex, singular values are always real and ≥ 0; SVD treats source and target as different spaces; they coincide only for symmetric positive semi-definite X. (The co-occurrence matrix is symmetric but not PSD — e.g. text "ABABAB…".)U、V 列正交归一；S 为对角阵。截断到秩 N：U~L×N​S~V~T；U~ 第 k 行就是第 k 个词的 N 维向量（潜在语义分析 LSA）。代价 ∝ LM2——昂贵且不能增量更新。与特征分解的区别：特征值可负或为复数，奇异值总是实数且 ≥ 0；SVD 把源和目标视为不同空间；仅当 X 对称半正定时二者相同。（共现矩阵对称但不是半正定——如文本 “ABABAB…”。）

10.3 word2vec (Mikolov et al. 2013) and GloVe10.3 word2vec（Mikolov 等 2013）与 GloVe

word2vec = predictive model: maximise the probability of words given nearby words. GloVe = count-based: reconstruct an approximation of the co-occurrence matrix. word2vec is a linear model (no activation at hidden units): one-hot input × W (V×N) → hidden h = the word's vector vk​; then uj​=vj′​Th for every vocabulary word, then softmax:word2vec = 预测式模型：最大化给定邻近词时某词出现的概率。GloVe = 计数式：重构共现矩阵的近似。word2vec 是线性模型（隐藏单元无激活函数）：独热输入 × W（V×N）→ 隐藏 h = 该词向量 vk​；再对每个词算 uj​=vj′​Th，然后 softmax：

prob(j∣k)=∑j′=1V​exp(vj′′​Tvk​)exp(vj′​Tvk​)​max T1​t=1∑T​−c≤r≤c, r=0∑​logprob(wt+r​∣wt​)​

With full softmax and correct output j∗: E=−uj∗​+log∑j′​exp(uj′​), ej​=∂E/∂uj​=prob(j)−δjj∗​; hidden-to-output gradient ej​hi​; input-to-hidden ∑j​ej​wij′​xk​.完整 softmax、正确输出为 j∗ 时：E=−uj∗​+log∑j′​exp(uj′​)，ej​=∂E/∂uj​=prob(j)−δjj∗​；隐藏到输出梯度 ej​hi​；输入到隐藏 ∑j​ej​wij′​xk​。

  • CBOW (Continuous Bag of Words): several context words predict the centre word; the hidden activation is the sum/average of their vectors; all context words share the same input-to-hidden weights (unlike NetTalk's position-specific weights).CBOW（连续词袋）：多个上下文词预测中心词；隐藏激活为它们向量的和/平均；所有上下文词共享同一组输入到隐藏权重（不同于 NetTalk 按位置区分的权重）。
  • Skip-gram: the centre word predicts each context word; all context words share the same hidden-to-output weights.Skip-gram：中心词预测每个上下文词；所有上下文词共享同一组隐藏到输出权重。
MAKING IT CHEAP (full softmax costs O(V) per word, V ≈ 60,000+)降低代价（完整 softmax 每个词代价 O(V)，V ≈ 6 万以上）
  • Hierarchical softmax: words are leaves of a Huffman-coded binary tree; each output corresponds to a branch point; only the ≈ log2​V nodes on the path to the target are evaluated: prob(w)=∏j​σ([[left/right]]vn(w,j)′​Th).层次 softmax：词是哈夫曼编码二叉树的叶子；每个输出对应一个分支点；只计算通向目标路径上的约 log2​V 个节点：prob(w)=∏j​σ([[左/右]]vn(w,j)′​Th)。
  • Negative sampling (simplified Noise-Contrastive Estimation): raise the target's score, lower only a few sampled "negative" words: E=−logσ(vj∗′​Th)−∑j∈Wneg​​logσ(−vj′​Th). 5–20 negatives for small data, 2–5 for large; draw from P(w)=U(w)3/4/Z. Not a proper distribution, but gives high-quality embeddings.负采样（简化版噪声对比估计）：提高目标词得分，只压低少量采样的“负”词：E=−logσ(vj∗′​Th)−∑j∈Wneg​​logσ(−vj′​Th)。小数据 5–20 个负样本，大数据 2–5 个；按 P(w)=U(w)3/4/Z 抽取。不是严格的概率分布，但嵌入质量很高。
  • Subsampling frequent words: discard each occurrence with probability P(wi​)=1−t/f(wi​)​, t≈10−5.高频词下采样：每次出现以概率 P(wi​)=1−t/f(wi​)​ 丢弃，t≈10−5。

10.4 Linguistic regularities and applications10.4 语言规律与应用

King + Woman − Man ≈ Queen. In general "A is to B as C is to ?":King + Woman − Man ≈ Queen。一般地，“A 之于 B 如同 C 之于 ?”：

d=argxmax​∥vc​+vb​−va​∥(vc​+vb​−va​)Tvx​​
  • Sentence completion and word-analogy tasks (pick the most likely word in context).句子补全与词语类比任务（选出语境中最可能的词）。
  • Multi-modal skip-gram: add an image term using CNN (e.g. AlexNet) features uw​ for words in ImageNet, with a max-margin cosine loss max(0,γ−cos(uwt​​,vwt​​)+cos(uwt​​,vj​)) — things that look similar get closer vectors.多模态 skip-gram：对 ImageNet 中有的词，加入基于 CNN（如 AlexNet）特征 uw​ 的图像项，用最大间隔余弦损失 max(0,γ−cos(uwt​​,vwt​​)+cos(uwt​​,vj​))——看起来相似的东西向量更接近。
  • Neural machine translation: bidirectional recurrent encoder + attention mechanism (the decoder looks back at relevant encoder states) — Google NMT; captioning with attention. This leads to Transformers (§11).神经机器翻译：双向循环编码器 + 注意力机制（解码器回看相关的编码器状态）——Google NMT；带注意力的图像描述。由此引出 Transformer（§11）。

Practice — Section 10练习 — 第 10 节

In the skip-gram model…在 skip-gram 模型中……

  1. the context words together predict the centre word上下文词共同预测中心词
  2. the centre word is used to predict each surrounding context word用中心词预测周围每个上下文词
  3. hidden units use a tanh activation隐藏单元使用 tanh 激活
  4. the co-occurrence matrix is factorised by SVD用 SVD 分解共现矩阵
(A) is CBOW. word2vec is linear at the hidden layer.（A）是 CBOW。word2vec 隐藏层是线性的。

Why does word2vec need hierarchical softmax or negative sampling?为什么 word2vec 需要层次 softmax 或负采样？

  1. Softmax cannot be differentiatedsoftmax 不可微
  2. To make the model nonlinear为了让模型非线性
  3. Full softmax requires computing a score for every vocabulary word for every training pair, which is too slow for large V完整 softmax 对每个训练对都要为词表中每个词算分数，V 大时太慢
  4. To remove stop words为了去除停用词
Hierarchical softmax: ≈ log₂V nodes; negative sampling: a handful of negatives.层次 softmax：约 log₂V 个节点；负采样：少量负样本。

Numerical. With t=10−5, what fraction of occurrences of a word with frequency f=0.01 is discarded by subsampling?数值题。t=10−5 时，频率 f=0.01 的词有多少比例的出现被下采样丢弃？

1−10−5/10−2​=1−0.001​=1−0.0316=0.968 (≈ 97% discarded).（约 97% 被丢弃）。

"Paris is to France as Tokyo is to ?" Using vector arithmetic, which vector should be closest to the answer?“Paris 之于 France 如同 Tokyo 之于 ?” 用向量运算，答案应最接近哪个向量？

  1. vFrance​−vParis​+vTokyo​
  2. vParis​−vFrance​+vTokyo​
  3. vFrance​+vParis​−vTokyo​
  4. vTokyo​−vFrance​
A=Paris, B=France, C=Tokyo: vc​+vb​−va​.A=Paris、B=France、C=Tokyo：vc​+vb​−va​。

Which statement about SVD vs eigenvalue decomposition is correct?关于 SVD 与特征分解，哪项正确？

  1. Singular values can be negative奇异值可以为负
  2. They always coincide for square matrices方阵时二者总相同
  3. SVD requires X to be symmetricSVD 要求 X 对称
  4. Singular values are always real and non-negative; the two coincide for symmetric positive semi-definite X奇异值总是非负实数；X 对称半正定时二者相同
Eigenvalues can be negative or complex (e.g. a rotation matrix).特征值可为负或复数（如旋转矩阵）。

In negative sampling, negative words are typically drawn from…负采样中，负样本词通常按什么分布抽取？

  1. the uniform distribution over the vocabulary词表上的均匀分布
  2. the unigram distribution raised to the power 3/4 (normalised)一元分布的 3/4 次方（归一化）
  3. the words in the current context window当前上下文窗口中的词
  4. the Huffman tree leaves on the target's path目标路径上的哈夫曼树叶子
P(w)=U(w)3/4/Z — flattens the distribution so rarer words are sampled a bit more often.——使分布更平，罕见词被抽到的概率略增。

GloVe differs from word2vec in that it is…GloVe 与 word2vec 的区别在于它是……

  1. a recurrent network循环网络
  2. supervised with human labels用人工标签监督
  3. count-based: it reconstructs an approximation of the co-occurrence matrix计数式的：重构共现矩阵的近似
  4. based on character n-grams only只基于字符 n-gram
word2vec is predictive.word2vec 是预测式的。

Short answer. Why is a co-occurrence row a poor word vector on its own, and name two ways to get compact vectors.简答。为什么共现矩阵的一行本身不是好的词向量？给出两种得到紧凑词向量的方法。

Its dimension equals the vocabulary size (~10⁵), it is sparse and noisy, and it is dominated by very common words, so similarity between rows is unreliable and storage is huge. Compact vectors: (1) truncated SVD of the co-occurrence matrix (keep the top N singular directions; row k of U~ = word vector) — expensive, ∝ LM2; (2) word2vec (CBOW / skip-gram) trained incrementally by prediction with negative sampling/hierarchical softmax and subsampling; (3) GloVe, fitting the co-occurrence counts.其维度等于词表大小（~10⁵），稀疏且噪声大，并被高频词主导，因此行之间的相似度不可靠、存储也巨大。紧凑向量：(1) 对共现矩阵做截断 SVD（保留前 N 个奇异方向；U~ 第 k 行即词向量）——代价 ∝ LM2；(2) word2vec（CBOW / skip-gram），通过预测增量训练，配合负采样/层次 softmax 与下采样；(3) GloVe，拟合共现计数。

🎯 Compute self-attention by hand; explain Q/K/V, scaling, multi-head, positions, residual + LayerNorm, FFN; contrast encoder-only (BERT), decoder-only (GPT) and encoder–decoder; explain the causal mask and cross-attention; know the complexity trade-off; understand long-context tricks, Mamba/SSMs, MoE, hybrids, diffusion LMs, RoPE and RAG at a conceptual level.🎯 手算自注意力；解释 Q/K/V、缩放、多头、位置编码、残差 + LayerNorm、FFN；对比仅编码器（BERT）、仅解码器（GPT）与编码器–解码器；解释因果掩码与交叉注意力；掌握复杂度权衡；在概念上理解长上下文技巧、Mamba/SSM、MoE、混合结构、扩散语言模型、RoPE 与 RAG。

11.1 Why Transformers? ("Attention Is All You Need", Vaswani et al. 2017)11.1 为什么是 Transformer？（《Attention Is All You Need》，Vaswani 等 2017）

In an RNN, "dogs" reaches the gap only through several updates of h (it fades; even an LSTM squeezes everything into one fixed-size state) and training must go step by step. In a Transformer every word reaches every other word in one step, and all positions are computed in parallel during training.在 RNN 中，“dogs” 要经过多次 h 更新才能到达空位（会衰减；即使 LSTM 也要把一切压进一个固定大小的状态），训练也须逐步进行。在 Transformer 中任何词一步就能到达任何其他词，训练时所有位置并行计算。

Encoder-only仅编码器Decoder-only仅解码器Encoder–decoder编码器–解码器
Example例子BERT (2018)GPT (2018)original (2017), T5原始模型（2017）、T5
Self-attention自注意力both directions, no mask双向，无掩码causal: itself and earlier tokens因果：只看自己和之前的词encoder both ways; decoder causal编码器双向；解码器因果
Cross-attention交叉注意力——decoder looks at encoder解码器看编码器
Output输出a vector per token每个词一个向量next token, one at a time逐个生成下一个词an output sequence输出序列
Training训练masked-token prediction遮词预测next-token prediction下一词预测seq-to-seq (next target token given input)序列到序列
Uses用途classification, tagging, search/embeddings分类、标注、搜索/嵌入text generation, chat, code (LLMs)文本生成、对话、代码（LLM）translation, summarisation翻译、摘要

11.2 Self-attention step by step11.2 自注意力逐步拆解

  1. Input X: one row per token = token embedding + position (+ segment in BERT). Attention alone ignores order (a weighted sum is permutation-invariant: "dog bites man" = "man bites dog"), hence positions must be added.输入 X：每个词一行 = 词嵌入 + 位置（BERT 还加段落向量）。注意力本身不考虑顺序（加权和与排列无关：“dog bites man” = “man bites dog”），所以必须加入位置。
  2. Query, key, value: Q=XWQ, K=XWK, V=XWV. Query = "what am I looking for?" (e.g. "it": which thing am I about?), key = "what can I be found by?", value = "what do I pass on?".查询、键、值：Q=XWQ, K=XWK, V=XWV。查询 = “我在找什么？”（如 “it”：我指的是哪个东西？），键 = “别人凭什么找到我？”，值 = “我传递什么信息？”。
  3. Scores S=QKT/dk​​ (n × n): how well token j's key matches token i's query. Dividing by dk​​ keeps scores in a good range (dot products grow with dimension; large scores make softmax too sharp).分数 S=QKT/dk​​（n × n）：词 j 的键与词 i 的查询的匹配程度。除以 dk​​ 让分数保持在合适范围（点积随维度增大；分数过大会使 softmax 过于尖锐）。
  4. Softmax each row → attention weights A (rows sum to 1).每行做 softmax → 注意力权重 A（每行和为 1）。
  5. Mix values Z=AV: each token's new vector is a weighted mix of the values it attends to ("it" now carries information from "animal").混合值 Z=AV：每个词的新向量是其关注的各值的加权混合（“it” 现在携带了 “animal” 的信息）。
THE EQUATION核心公式
Attention(Q,K,V)=softmax(dk​​QKT​+M)V
M=0 for the encoder; for the decoder Mij​=−∞ if j>i (causal mask: e−∞=0, so later tokens get exactly 0 weight). Fast because it is all matrix products on a GPU.编码器中 M=0；解码器中若 j>i 则 Mij​=−∞（因果掩码：e−∞=0，后面的词权重恰为 0）。全部是矩阵乘法，在 GPU 上很快。
WORKED EXAMPLE (d_k = 2)例题（d_k = 2）
Query q=[1,0]; keys k1​=[1,0],k2​=[0,1],k3​=[1,1]; values equal to the keys.查询 q=[1,0]；键 k1​=[1,0],k2​=[0,1],k3​=[1,1]；值与键相同。
  1. Scores分数 q⋅kj​/2​=(0.707, 0, 0.707)
  2. Softmaxsoftmax: e0.707=2.028 ⇒ A=(2.028,1,2.028)/5.056=(0.401,0.198,0.401)
  3. z=0.401[1,0]+0.198[0,1]+0.401[1,1]=[0.802, 0.599]
With a causal mask, the 2nd token (query [0,1]) may only see keys 1–2: scores (0, 0.707) → weights (0.330, 0.670).加因果掩码时，第 2 个词（查询 [0,1]）只能看键 1–2：分数 (0, 0.707) → 权重 (0.330, 0.670)。

11.3 Completing the layer11.3 补全一层的结构

  • Multi-head attention: one head makes one weighted mix and tends to follow one kind of link; several heads, each with its own WQ,WK,WV, look for different things at once: Z(m)=softmax(Q(m)K(m)T/dk​​)V(m). Concatenate the heads and mix with WO.多头注意力：一个头只做一种加权混合，倾向于捕捉一种关系；多个头各有自己的 WQ,WK,WV，同时关注不同的东西：Z(m)=softmax(Q(m)K(m)T/dk​​)V(m)。拼接各头再用 WO 混合。
  • Add & Norm: residual U=X+MHA(X), then layer normalisation per row: LN(u)c​=γc​(uc​−μ)/σ2+ε​+βc​ — numbers drift between layers; big values make softmax/GELU too sharp and training unstable. Original/BERT: post-norm (after the add); GPT: pre-norm (X′=LN(X) before each sublayer, plus a final LN).Add & Norm：残差 U=X+MHA(X)，然后对每行做层归一化：LN(u)c​=γc​(uc​−μ)/σ2+ε​+βc​——数值会在层间漂移；数值过大使 softmax/GELU 过于尖锐、训练不稳定。原始模型/BERT：后归一化（相加之后）；GPT：前归一化（每个子层前先 X′=LN(X)，最后再加一个 LN）。
  • Feed-forward network on each token separately: FFN(h)=GELU(hW1​+b1​)W2​+b2​ (widen, usually ×4, then shrink back) — adds non-linear transformation.前馈网络对每个词单独作用：FFN(h)=GELU(hW1​+b1​)W2​+b2​（先加宽，通常 ×4，再缩回）——提供非线性变换。
  • Stack N layers (each with its own weights); the output is one context-dependent vector per token.堆叠 N 层（每层权重不同）；输出是每个词一个依赖上下文的向量。

11.4 Encoder (BERT)11.4 编码器（BERT）

Input: [CLS] tokens [SEP], with xi​=E[ti​]+sA​+P[i] (token + segment + learned position). Pre-training: masked language model — choose 15% of tokens; of these 80% → [MASK], 10% → a random token, 10% unchanged; loss −lnP(hidden word) summed over chosen positions; plus next-sentence prediction (original BERT). Fine-tuning: keep the pre-trained weights, swap the head (e.g. [CLS] → positive/negative), train briefly (small learning rate, 2–4 passes) on thousands of labelled examples. Probing: freeze BERT, train small classifiers on one layer's vectors to see what it holds (surface info low, syntax middle, semantics higher). Used in Google Search from 2019. Variants: BERT-base 12×768 (110M), BERT-large 24×1024 (340M), RoBERTa (more data, no NSP), DistilBERT (6 layers, 97% of the performance, 60% faster), ALBERT (shared weights across layers), ModernBERT (RoPE, longer context). 输入：[CLS] 词序列 [SEP]，xi​=E[ti​]+sA​+P[i]（词 + 段落 + 可学习位置）。预训练：遮蔽语言模型——选 15% 的词；其中 80% 换成 [MASK]、10% 换成随机词、10% 不变；损失为所选位置上 −lnP(被遮词) 之和；外加下一句预测（原版 BERT）。微调：保留预训练权重，换头部（如 [CLS] → 正面/负面），在数千个标注样本上短暂训练（小学习率、2–4 轮）。探测：冻结 BERT，在某一层的向量上训练小分类器，看它包含什么信息（表层信息在低层、句法在中层、语义更高层）。2019 年起用于 Google 搜索。变体：BERT-base 12×768（1.1 亿）、BERT-large 24×1024（3.4 亿）、RoBERTa（更多数据、去掉 NSP）、DistilBERT（6 层，保留 97% 性能、快 60%）、ALBERT（各层共享权重）、ModernBERT（RoPE、更长上下文）。

11.5 Decoder (GPT) and LLMs11.5 解码器（GPT）与大语言模型

GPT = the encoder layer with one change: a causal mask. Embeddings = token + position (no [CLS]/[SEP]/segment). Pre-norm layers, final LN, then a linear layer (often tied to the embedding matrix ET) + softmax gives P(next token). Loss: every position guesses its next token in parallel: L=−∑i​lnP(ti+1​∣t0​,…,ti​). Generation: sample a token, append it, repeat. Fine-tuned examples: Codex/GitHub Copilot (code). An LLM is a very large decoder-only Transformer; stages: (1) pre-training on web text/books/code, (2) supervised instruction tuning, (3) preference tuning with RL (RLHF — see §12). GPT = 编码器层 + 一个改动：因果掩码。嵌入 = 词 + 位置（无 [CLS]/[SEP]/段落）。前归一化层、最后一个 LN，再接线性层（常与嵌入矩阵 ET 共享）+ softmax 得到 P(下一个词)。损失：每个位置并行地猜下一个词：L=−∑i​lnP(ti+1​∣t0​,…,ti​)。生成：采样一个词，接到末尾，重复。微调实例：Codex/GitHub Copilot（代码）。LLM 就是超大规模的仅解码器 Transformer；阶段：(1) 在网页、书籍、代码上预训练，(2) 监督式指令微调，(3) 用强化学习做偏好微调（RLHF——见 §12）。

11.6 Encoder–decoder: the original Transformer11.6 编码器–解码器：原始 Transformer

  • Sinusoidal positions: pairs of sin/cos at different speeds (fast pair distinguishes neighbours but wraps every ~6.3 positions; slow pair hardly moves within a sentence but separates far positions) — together every position gets a unique pattern.正弦位置编码：不同频率的 sin/cos 成对出现（快的一对区分相邻位置，但约每 6.3 个位置绕一圈；慢的一对在句内几乎不动，但能区分远距离位置）——组合起来每个位置都有独特模式。
  • Decoder input shifted right: in training the real French is known; the decoder reads it behind a start token <s> one place late, and each position predicts the next token (teacher forcing) — all positions trained in one parallel pass.解码器输入右移：训练时已知真实法文；解码器在起始符 <s> 后晚一位读入，每个位置预测下一个词（教师强制）——所有位置一次并行训练。
  • Cross-attention: queries come from the decoder, keys and values from the encoder output — each French position fetches what it needs from the English. Then Add & Norm and FFN.交叉注意力：查询来自解码器，键和值来自编码器输出——每个法文位置从英文中取所需信息。之后 Add & Norm 和 FFN。
  • Translating new text: the next token is unknown, so one decoder pass per output token (autoregressive).翻译新文本：下一个词未知，因此每生成一个词就要做一次解码器前向（自回归）。
Layer type (n tokens, d dims)层类型（n 个词，d 维）Work per layer每层计算量Sequential steps串行步数Longest path最长路径
Self-attention自注意力O(n2d)O(1)O(1)
Recurrent (RNN/LSTM)循环（RNN/LSTM）O(nd2)O(n)O(n)

11.7 Beyond the 2017 paper11.7 2017 年论文之后的发展

LONG CONTEXTS (attention costs ≈ n²/2 scores per head per layer)长上下文（注意力每头每层约 n²/2 个分数）
  • Sparse attention — compute fewer pairs (∝ n·k): Longformer (sliding window + global tokens), BigBird (+ random links), NSA (model selects blocks via compressed summaries).稀疏注意力——少算一些对（∝ n·k）：Longformer（滑动窗口 + 全局词）、BigBird（+ 随机连接）、NSA（模型通过压缩摘要选择块）。
  • FlashAttention — compute all pairs exactly but move less data: tiles stay in fast on-chip memory, the n×n table is never written to GPU main memory (work ∝ n², memory ∝ n).FlashAttention——精确计算全部对，但少搬数据：分块留在片上高速存储，从不把 n×n 表写进显存（计算 ∝ n²，内存 ∝ n）。
  • Linear attention — change the maths: work ∝ n, fixed d×d memory when generating (like an RNN), but "blurry" memory: exact recall of one earlier token is harder; softmax attention remains the quality reference.线性注意力——改变数学形式：计算 ∝ n，生成时内存为固定的 d×d（像 RNN），但记忆“模糊”：精确回忆某个早先的词更难；softmax 注意力仍是质量基准。
STATE-SPACE MODELS (Mamba, Gu & Dao 2023)状态空间模型（Mamba，Gu & Dao 2023）
RNN: ht​=tanh(Whh​ht−1​+Wxh​xt​+b) — nonlinear in the state, must be computed in order. SSM: ht​=Aˉht−1​+Bˉxt​, yt​=Cht​ — linear in the state, so it unrolls into a sum ht​=∑k≤t​Aˉt−kBˉxk​ ⇒ parallel training algorithms, cost ∝ L, fixed-size state for fast generation. Selective (Mamba): Δ, B, C are computed from each token, so the model chooses what to remember. Mamba block: RMSNorm → Linear (D→2D, main path u and gate z) → causal Conv1d (short-range) → SiLU → selective SSM → multiply by SiLU(z) gate → Linear (2D→D). Weakness: fixed-size state is lossy (can't recall a whole phone book). RNN：ht​=tanh(Whh​ht−1​+Wxh​xt​+b)——对状态非线性，必须按顺序计算。SSM：ht​=Aˉht−1​+Bˉxt​, yt​=Cht​——对状态线性，可展开成求和 ht​=∑k≤t​Aˉt−kBˉxk​ ⇒ 可并行训练、代价 ∝ L、生成时状态大小固定。选择性（Mamba）：Δ、B、C 由每个词计算，模型可选择记住什么。Mamba 块：RMSNorm → 线性（D→2D，主路径 u 与门 z）→ 因果 Conv1d（短程）→ SiLU → 选择性 SSM → 乘以 SiLU(z) 门 → 线性（2D→D）。弱点：固定大小的状态有损（记不住整本电话簿）。
Vanilla RNN普通 RNNLSTM / GRUTransformerMamba
Far memory远程记忆poor (vanishing)差（梯度消失）good (gated cell)好（门控细胞）exact (reads every token)精确（读取每个词）good but lossy fixed state好，但固定状态有损
Training训练step by step逐步step by step逐步parallel并行parallel并行
Cost in length L随长度的代价∝ L∝ L∝ L²∝ L
  • Mixture of Experts (MoE): the FFN is split into many experts; a trainable router sends each token to a few (top-k) of them → many more weights (knowledge) without more work per token. E.g. Mixtral 8×7B: 47B total / 13B used; DeepSeek-V3: 671B / 37B.混合专家（MoE）：把 FFN 拆成许多专家；可训练的路由器把每个词送到其中少数几个（top-k）→ 权重（知识容量）大增而每个词的计算量不增。如 Mixtral 8×7B：总 470 亿 / 实际使用 130 亿；DeepSeek-V3：6710 亿 / 370 亿。
  • Hybrids: attention keeps every earlier token exactly (KV cache grows with the text: 414.7 MB at 8K tokens for a 300M Transformer) while recurrent/SSM/linear layers keep a fixed-size summary (1.9 MB for a 300M Mamba). Mix them: a few full-attention layers as "anchors" + many SSM/linear or sliding-window layers (Hymba, Nemotron 3, Qwen3.5).混合结构：注意力精确保存每个早先的词（KV 缓存随文本增长：300M Transformer 在 8K 词时 414.7 MB），而循环/SSM/线性层只保留固定大小的摘要（300M Mamba 为 1.9 MB）。混合使用：少量全注意力层作“锚点” + 大量 SSM/线性或滑动窗口层（Hymba、Nemotron 3、Qwen3.5）。
  • Diffusion language models: DDPM for images adds Gaussian noise step by step and learns to remove it; for text the "noise" is masking (D3PM): forward masks each token with probability t; reverse = a BERT-like Transformer (no causal mask) predicts all masks at once; generates many tokens per step ⇒ fast (Mercury, DiffusionGemma).扩散语言模型：图像 DDPM 逐步加高斯噪声并学习去噪；文本中的“噪声”是遮蔽（D3PM）：前向以概率 t 遮蔽每个词；反向 = 类 BERT 的 Transformer（无因果掩码）一次预测所有被遮词；每步生成多个词 ⇒ 速度快（Mercury、DiffusionGemma）。
  • RoPE (rotary positions): instead of adding a position, rotate each pair of query/key numbers by an angle ∝ position: qi′​=R(iθ)qi​, kj′​=R(jθ)kj​⇒qi′​⋅kj′​=qi​⋅R((j−i)θ)kj​ — the score depends only on the relative position.RoPE（旋转位置编码）：不再加位置向量，而是把查询/键的每对数按与位置成正比的角度旋转：qi′​=R(iθ)qi​, kj′​=R(jθ)kj​⇒qi′​⋅kj′​=qi​⋅R((j−i)θ)kj​——分数只依赖相对位置。
  • RAG (retrieval-augmented generation, Lewis 2020): an LLM only knows its frozen training text and may hallucinate; so first encode the question, retrieve the top-k most similar passages from an index (cosine similarity q⋅d/(∣q∣∣d∣)), put them into the prompt, then generate.RAG（检索增强生成，Lewis 2020）：LLM 只知道冻结在权重中的训练文本，可能“幻觉”；所以先编码问题，从索引中检索最相似的前 k 段（余弦相似度 q⋅d/(∣q∣∣d∣)），放进提示词，再生成答案。

Practice — Section 11练习 — 第 11 节

Numerical. One attention head, dk​=2. Query q=[0,2]; keys k1​=[1,1], k2​=[0,−1]; values v1​=[2,0], v2​=[0,4]. Compute the attention weights and the output (2 d.p.).数值题。单头注意力，dk​=2。查询 q=[0,2]；键 k1​=[1,1], k2​=[0,−1]；值 v1​=[2,0], v2​=[0,4]。求注意力权重与输出（两位小数）。

Scores: 2/2​=1.414, −2/2​=−1.414. Softmax: e1.414=4.11, e−1.414=0.243 ⇒ weights (0.94, 0.06). Output = 0.94[2,0]+0.06[0,4] = [1.89, 0.22].分数：2/2​=1.414，−2/2​=−1.414。softmax：e1.414=4.11, e−1.414=0.243 ⇒ 权重 (0.94, 0.06)。输出 = 0.94[2,0]+0.06[0,4] = [1.89, 0.22]。

In encoder–decoder cross-attention, where do Q, K and V come from?编码器–解码器交叉注意力中，Q、K、V 分别来自哪里？

  1. Q, K, V all from the encoderQ、K、V 都来自编码器
  2. Q from the decoder; K and V from the encoder outputQ 来自解码器；K、V 来自编码器输出
  3. Q from the encoder; K and V from the decoderQ 来自编码器；K、V 来自解码器
  4. all from the decoder, with a causal mask都来自解码器，加因果掩码
Each target position asks (query) for information stored in the source (keys/values).每个目标位置（查询）去源句（键/值）中取信息。

What does the causal mask in GPT do?GPT 中的因果掩码有什么作用？

  1. Hides 15% of the input tokens遮住 15% 的输入词
  2. Removes padding tokens only只去掉填充词
  3. Makes attention symmetric让注意力对称
  4. Adds −∞ to scores for later positions so each token attends only to itself and earlier tokens给后面位置的分数加 −∞，使每个词只关注自己和之前的词
(A) is BERT's masked LM, which is different.（A）是 BERT 的遮蔽语言模型，二者不同。

Why are attention scores divided by dk​​?为什么注意力分数要除以 dk​​？

  1. Dot products grow with dimension; scaling keeps softmax from becoming too sharp (saturated)点积随维度增大；缩放防止 softmax 过于尖锐（饱和）
  2. To make the weights sum to 1使权重和为 1
  3. To implement the causal mask为了实现因果掩码
  4. To encode position为了编码位置
Softmax already normalises; scaling controls the range of scores.softmax 本身已归一化；缩放是为了控制分数范围。

Per layer, self-attention costs O(n2d) while an RNN costs O(nd2). The main advantage of self-attention is…每层自注意力代价 O(n2d)，RNN 为 O(nd2)。自注意力的主要优势是……

  1. it always needs less arithmetic总是需要更少的运算
  2. it has no parameters没有参数
  3. O(1) sequential steps and O(1) path length between any two positions串行步数 O(1)，任意两位置之间路径长度 O(1)
  4. its memory does not depend on n内存与 n 无关
Parallel training and short paths for long-range dependencies; the cost is quadratic in n.可并行训练、长程依赖路径短；代价是对 n 二次方。

In BERT pre-training, of the 15% of tokens chosen for prediction…BERT 预训练中，被选中预测的 15% 的词……

  1. all are replaced by [MASK]全部换成 [MASK]
  2. 80% → [MASK], 10% → random token, 10% unchanged80% → [MASK]，10% → 随机词，10% 不变
  3. half are deleted一半被删除
  4. they are predicted left-to-right从左到右预测
So the model can't rely on seeing [MASK] at fine-tuning time.这样模型不能依赖在微调时也看到 [MASK]。

Numerical. A Transformer layer has dmodel​=512, 8 heads (each dk​=64), and an FFN 512→2048→512. Ignoring biases and LayerNorm, how many weights are in (a) multi-head attention (incl. WO), (b) the FFN?数值题。某 Transformer 层 dmodel​=512，8 个头（每头 dk​=64），FFN 为 512→2048→512。忽略偏置与 LayerNorm，(a) 多头注意力（含 WO）、(b) FFN 各有多少权重？

(a) WQ,WK,WV: 3 × 512×512 (8 heads × 64 = 512 columns) + WO 512×512 ⇒ 4×262,144 = 1,048,576. (b) 2×512×2048 = 2,097,152 (FFN holds about 2/3 of the layer's weights — that is why MoE splits the FFN).(a) WQ,WK,WV：3 × 512×512（8 头 × 64 = 512 列）+ WO 512×512 ⇒ 4×262,144 = 1,048,576。(b) 2×512×2048 = 2,097,152（FFN 约占该层 2/3 的权重——这正是 MoE 拆分 FFN 的原因）。

With RoPE, the attention score between positions i and j depends on…使用 RoPE 时，位置 i 与 j 之间的注意力分数取决于……

  1. i only只与 i 有关
  2. i + ji + j
  3. the relative offset j − i (and the contents q, k)相对偏移 j − i（及内容 q、k）
  4. nothing — RoPE removes position无关——RoPE 去除了位置
R(iθ)TR(jθ)=R((j−i)θ).

A Mixture-of-Experts model has 671B total weights but uses 37B per token. This is possible because…某 MoE 模型共有 6710 亿权重，但每个词只用 370 亿。这是因为……

  1. most weights are frozen embeddings大部分权重是冻结的嵌入
  2. attention is skipped for most tokens大部分词跳过注意力
  3. weights are quantised to 1 bit权重被量化为 1 比特
  4. a router sends each token through only a few of the many feed-forward experts路由器只把每个词送入众多前馈专家中的少数几个
More capacity without more compute per token.容量更大而每个词的计算量不增。

Why can a state-space model like Mamba be trained in parallel while a vanilla RNN cannot?为什么 Mamba 这类状态空间模型能并行训练，而普通 RNN 不能？

  1. Its state update is linear (no tanh on h), so ht​ can be written as a sum over inputs and computed with parallel algorithms状态更新是线性的（h 上无 tanh），ht​ 可写成输入的求和，用并行算法计算
  2. It has no hidden state没有隐藏状态
  3. It uses attention over all tokens对所有词使用注意力
  4. It only processes the last token只处理最后一个词
ht​=∑k≤t​Aˉt−kBˉxk​.

Numerical (RAG). Question vector q=[0.8,0.5,0.1,0.2]. Passage A =[0.7,0.6,0.2,0.1], passage B =[0.1,0.2,0.9,0.3]. Which passage is retrieved (cosine similarity)?数值题（RAG）。问题向量 q=[0.8,0.5,0.1,0.2]。段落 A =[0.7,0.6,0.2,0.1]，段落 B =[0.1,0.2,0.9,0.3]。按余弦相似度检索哪一段？

|q| = 0.970. A: q·d = 0.90, |d| = 0.949 ⇒ cos = 0.98. B: q·d = 0.08+0.10+0.09+0.06 = 0.33, |d| = √0.95 = 0.975 ⇒ cos = 0.35. Retrieve A.检索 A。

Short answer (3 marks). Compare BERT and GPT: architecture, training objective, and typical uses.简答（3 分）。从结构、训练目标和典型用途比较 BERT 与 GPT。

Architecture: both are stacks of Transformer layers (multi-head self-attention + FFN with residuals and LayerNorm). BERT is encoder-only with bidirectional (unmasked) attention and inputs [CLS]…[SEP] with token+segment+position embeddings; GPT is decoder-only with a causal mask so each token sees only earlier tokens. Objective: BERT — masked-language-model (predict 15% hidden tokens; originally also next-sentence prediction); GPT — next-token prediction at every position. Uses: BERT produces contextual vectors per token → fine-tuned for classification, tagging, search/embeddings; GPT generates text one token at a time → LLMs, chat, code (Codex), after instruction tuning and RLHF.结构：二者都是 Transformer 层堆叠（多头自注意力 + FFN，带残差和 LayerNorm）。BERT 仅编码器，双向（无掩码）注意力，输入为 [CLS]…[SEP]，嵌入 = 词 + 段落 + 位置；GPT 仅解码器，带因果掩码，每个词只看之前的词。目标：BERT——遮蔽语言模型（预测被遮的 15% 词；原版还有下一句预测）；GPT——每个位置预测下一个词。用途：BERT 产生每个词的上下文向量 → 微调用于分类、标注、搜索/嵌入；GPT 逐词生成文本 → 经指令微调和 RLHF 后成为 LLM、对话、代码（Codex）。

🎯 Set up an RL problem (S, A, T, R, π); compute returns under different reward goals; evaluate a policy and find V*, Q* in a small deterministic world (sample-exam numerical!); run TD(0) and Q-learning updates by hand; explain exploration, DQN's tricks, REINFORCE, actor–critic/advantage, PPO and GRPO, and RL for LLMs (RLHF, DPO, RLVR).🎯 建立强化学习问题（S、A、T、R、π）；按不同奖励目标计算回报；在小型确定性环境中评估策略并求 V*、Q*（样卷数值题！）；手算 TD(0) 与 Q-learning 更新；解释探索、DQN 的技巧、REINFORCE、Actor–Critic/优势函数、PPO 与 GRPO，以及 LLM 中的强化学习（RLHF、DPO、RLVR）。

12.1 What is RL?12.1 什么是强化学习？

RL: an agent learns, by trial and error, a policy that maximises its expected total future reward — not just the next reward. Use RL when decisions are sequential (actions change what happens next, rewards may be delayed), there is a score but no labels, and you can try things (simulator, game). If you know the right action for each input, use supervised learning (much less data). If you can't try things, ordinary RL is out (offline RL is harder).强化学习：智能体通过试错学习一个策略，以最大化期望的未来总奖励——而不仅是下一步奖励。适用于：序贯决策（动作影响之后发生的事，奖励可能延迟）、有分数但无标签、可以反复尝试（模拟器、游戏）。若已知每个输入的正确动作，用监督学习（数据少得多）。若无法尝试，普通 RL 不适用（离线 RL 更难）。

WHY NOT JUST COPY AN EXPERT? (behavioural cloning)为什么不直接模仿专家？（行为克隆）
(1) Needs an expert — often nobody can demonstrate the best action (how hard to push each leg motor of a robot dog). (2) Errors compound — one slip leads to states the expert never showed; total error can grow like H2 over H steps. (3) Can't beat the teacher — copies what the expert did, not why.(1) 需要专家——很多任务没人能示范最佳动作（机器狗每条腿电机该用多大力）。(2) 误差累积——一次失误就进入专家从未展示过的状态；H 步内总误差可按 H2 增长。(3) 无法超越老师——只模仿专家做了什么，而不是为什么。

Model-free agents learn only from real experience; model-based agents also use a model (their own simulator: given (s, a), predict s′ and r — given, e.g. game rules, or learned) to plan or imagine experience (chess player thinking "if I move my queen here…"). History: Samuel's checkers (1959, planning with a model), MENACE (1961, matchboxes and beads as a policy), TD-Gammon, DQN, AlphaGo.无模型智能体只从真实经验中学习；基于模型的智能体还使用模型（自己的模拟器：给定 (s, a) 预测 s′ 与 r——可给定，如游戏规则，也可学习）来规划或想象经验（棋手想“如果我把后走到这……”）。历史：Samuel 跳棋（1959，基于模型规划）、MENACE（1961，用火柴盒和珠子表示策略）、TD-Gammon、DQN、AlphaGo。

12.2 The framework and reward goals12.2 框架与奖励目标

  • Transitions and policies can be deterministic or stochastic (slippery floor: ↑ moves up 80%, slips left/right 10% each). Sometimes the best policy is random (rock–paper–scissors against an opponent; states that look identical).转移和策略可以是确定性的或随机的（湿滑地板：↑ 有 80% 上移、各 10% 向左/右滑）。有时最优策略是随机的（与对手玩石头剪刀布；看起来一样的状态）。
THREE REWARD GOALS三种奖励目标
Finite horizon:有限视野： E[∑k=0h−1​rt+k​]   Discounted (the return):折扣（回报）： Gt​=E[∑k=0∞​γkrt+k​], 0≤γ<1   Average:平均： limh→∞​E[h1​∑k=0h−1​rt+k​]
Geometric series: 1+γ+γ2+⋯=1−γ1​; a reward R every step starting after n zero steps is worth 1−γRγn​.几何级数：1+γ+γ2+⋯=1−γ1​；先有 n 步奖励为 0、之后每步奖励 R，其价值为 1−γRγn​。

The reward goal is part of the problem definition. From now on: discounted.奖励目标是问题定义的一部分。此后统一用折扣回报。

12.3 Value functions and the Bellman equation12.3 价值函数与贝尔曼方程

Two routes to a good policy: value-based (learn how good each state/action is, then act greedily) and policy-based (learn which action to take directly).得到好策略有两条路：基于价值（学每个状态/动作有多好，再贪心行动）和基于策略（直接学该采取什么动作）。

DEFINITIONS定义
Vπ(s)=Eπ​[k≥0∑​γkrt+k​ ​ st​=s]Qπ(s,a)=Eπ​[k≥0∑​γkrt+k​ ​ st​=s,at​=a]​
Bellman equation (value now = reward now + γ × value next):贝尔曼方程（当前价值 = 当前奖励 + γ × 下一状态价值）：
Vπ(s)=E[rt​+γVπ(st+1​)∣st​=s]
Optimality (deterministic world):最优性（确定性环境）：
Q∗(s,a)=r(s,a)+γbmax​Q∗(δ(s,a),b)V∗(s)=amax​Q∗(s,a)π∗(s)=argamax​Q∗(s,a)​
CHECK A VALUE (random policy, γ = 0.9)验证一个价值（随机策略，γ = 0.9）
Cell next to the dock, V = 0.26. Moves (prob ¼ each): → dock: 1+0.9×0 = 1; ↑ wall, stays: 0+0.9×0.26 = 0.23; ← : 0.9×0.13 = 0.12; ↓ : 0.9×(−0.34) = −0.31. Average = ¼(1.04) ≈ 0.26 ✓. Random moving is far from optimal.充电座旁的格子，V = 0.26。各动作（概率各 ¼）：→ 充电座：1+0.9×0 = 1；↑ 撞墙原地：0+0.9×0.26 = 0.23；←：0.9×0.13 = 0.12；↓：0.9×(−0.34) = −0.31。平均 = ¼(1.04) ≈ 0.26 ✓。随机移动远非最优。
DELAYED REWARD: pay before you profit (lecture exercises)延迟奖励：先付出再获益（讲义练习）
Deterministic chain s1, s2, s3, γ = 0.9. In s1: a1 stays (+1), a2 → s2 (−1). In s2: a1 → s3 (−1). In s3: a2 stays (+2).确定性链 s1、s2、s3，γ = 0.9。s1：a1 原地（+1），a2 → s2（−1）。s2：a1 → s3（−1）。s3：a2 原地（+2）。
  • Ex 1 (stay in s3 forever): V=2+0.9V⇒V=2/(1−0.9)=20.练习 1（永远留在 s3）：V=2+0.9V⇒V=2/(1−0.9)=20。
  • Ex 2a short-sighted agent in s1 takes +1 forever: 1/(1−0.9)=10.练习 2a：短视智能体在 s1 一直拿 +1：1/(1−0.9)=10。
  • Ex 2b/c: best loop is staying in s3 (+2/step). Work backwards: V∗(s3)=20, V∗(s2)=−1+0.9(20)=17, V∗(s1)=−1+0.9(17)=14.3>10. Accepting −1 twice pays off.练习 2b/c：最佳循环是留在 s3（每步 +2）。倒推：V∗(s3)=20，V∗(s2)=−1+0.9(20)=17，V∗(s1)=−1+0.9(17)=14.3>10。接受两次 −1 是值得的。

12.4 Temporal-difference learning (model-free)12.4 时序差分学习（无模型）

Without T and R we can't average over moves — but we can try an action and watch. In a deterministic world, overwrite V(st​)←rt​+γV(st+1​); in a random world, move only a fraction η:没有 T 和 R 就无法对各动作取平均——但可以试一下再观察。确定性环境中直接覆盖 V(st​)←rt​+γV(st+1​)；随机环境中只移动一小步 η：

TD(0) UPDATETD(0) 更新
V(st​)←V(st​)+η[TD targetrt​+γV(st+1​)​​−V(st​)]
Bootstrapping = improving a guess using another guess (V(st+1​)). Like estimating your commute: after 10 real minutes to the station, guess 25 more ⇒ update to 35 now without waiting to arrive.自举 = 用另一个估计来改进估计（V(st+1​)）。就像估计通勤时间：实际走到车站花了 10 分钟，估计后面还要 25 分钟 ⇒ 现在就更新为 35，而不必等到达。

Chain A → B → C → Goal (+1), all V start at 0: reward news flows backwards one state per episode (C first, then B, then A). With η = 1 and deterministic reward: exact after 3 episodes (C = 1, B = 0.9, A = 0.81). With random rewards (coin flip 0/1): η = 1 copies the last flip and never settles; η = 0.5 smoother but noisy; decaying η = 1/n converges (to 0.5, 0.45, 0.405).链 A → B → C → 目标（+1），V 初始都为 0：奖励信息每个回合向后传播一个状态（先 C，再 B，再 A）。η = 1 且奖励确定时：3 个回合后精确（C = 1，B = 0.9，A = 0.81）。奖励随机（抛硬币 0/1）时：η = 1 只会复制最后一次结果、永不收敛；η = 0.5 平滑些但仍有噪声；递减的 η = 1/n 收敛（到 0.5、0.45、0.405）。

TD(λ) blends n-step targets (1 real reward then a guess, 2 real rewards then a guess, …, to the end). Weight of the n-step target ∝ (1−λ)λn−1. λ = 0 ⇒ TD(0) (trust guesses; good when guesses are already good); λ = 1 ⇒ full Monte-Carlo return (trust real rewards; good for short episodes / poor early guesses); in between usually best (news travels faster than λ = 0, less noise than λ = 1). TD-Gammon used TD(λ).TD(λ) 融合 n 步目标（1 个真实奖励再接估计、2 个真实奖励再接估计……直到结束）。n 步目标的权重 ∝ (1−λ)λn−1。λ = 0 ⇒ TD(0)（相信估计；估计已较准时好）；λ = 1 ⇒ 完整蒙特卡洛回报（相信真实奖励；回合短/早期估计差时好）；中间值通常最好（信息传得比 λ = 0 快，噪声比 λ = 1 小）。TD-Gammon 使用 TD(λ)。

12.5 Q-learning and exploration12.5 Q-learning 与探索

Q-LEARNING (Watkins)Q-learning（Watkins）
Q(s,a)←Q(s,a)+η[r+γbmax​Q(s′,b)−Q(s,a)](target=r if s′ terminal)​
Compared with TD(0): we update an action value, and the target takes the max over next actions — the best next move, even if the agent doesn't take it (so it learns Q* while exploring: off-policy). Parameters: η ≈ 0.1–0.5, γ ≈ 0.9–0.99, ε.与 TD(0) 相比：更新的是动作价值，目标取下一状态所有动作的最大值——即使智能体并不采取那个最佳动作（所以能边探索边学到 Q*：离策略）。参数：η ≈ 0.1–0.5，γ ≈ 0.9–0.99，ε。
EXPLORATION vs EXPLOITATION探索与利用
  • ε-greedy: with prob 1−ε take the best-looking action, with prob ε a random one (ε = 0.05–0.1, often decayed from 1.0 to ~0.01).ε-贪心：以概率 1−ε 选当前看起来最好的动作，以概率 ε 随机选（ε = 0.05–0.1，常从 1.0 递减到约 0.01）。
  • Softmax (Boltzmann): P(a)∝eQ(a)/τ; low temperature τ ≈ greedy, high τ ≈ uniform.Softmax（玻尔兹曼）：P(a)∝eQ(a)/τ；温度 τ 低 ≈ 贪心，τ 高 ≈ 均匀。
  • 10-armed bandit testbed: greedy plateaus ≈ 1.03 (stuck on a mediocre arm, best arm 35%); ε = 0.1 climbs fastest to ≈ 1.35 (best arm 79%) but keeps exploring forever; best possible ≈ 1.54.10 臂老虎机实验：贪心停在约 1.03（卡在一般的臂上，选中最佳臂仅 35%）；ε = 0.1 上升最快，达约 1.35（最佳臂 79%），但永远保持探索；理论最优约 1.54。

Convergence (Watkins & Dayan 1992): tabular Q-learning converges to Q* with probability 1 in any finite problem if every (s, a) is tried infinitely often, step sizes satisfy ∑ηn​=∞, ∑ηn2​<∞, rewards are bounded and γ < 1. "Enough exploration" can be astronomically large.收敛性（Watkins & Dayan 1992）：在任何有限问题中，若每个 (s, a) 被尝试无穷多次、步长满足 ∑ηn​=∞, ∑ηn2​<∞、奖励有界且 γ < 1，表格型 Q-learning 以概率 1 收敛到 Q*。“足够的探索”可能是天文数字。

12.6 Deep Q-networks (DQN)12.6 深度 Q 网络（DQN）

Replace the table with a network Qw​(s,⋅) (one output per action). Training targets can come from TD (y=r+γVw​(s′)), from copying experts, or from search. Naive deep Q-learning is unstable: consecutive samples are correlated, and the target moves every time w changes. DQN's fixes:用网络 Qw​(s,⋅) 代替表格（每个动作一个输出）。训练目标可来自 TD（y=r+γVw​(s′)）、模仿专家或搜索。朴素深度 Q-learning 不稳定：连续样本高度相关，且每次 w 变化目标也跟着动。DQN 的解决办法：

  • Experience replay: store (s, a, r, s′) in a buffer (last N = 1M transitions) and learn from random mini-batches (32) — breaks correlations, re-uses data (~8× each).经验回放：把 (s, a, r, s′) 存进缓冲区（最近 N = 100 万条），从随机小批量（32）学习——打破相关性、重复利用数据（每条约 8 次）。
  • Prioritised replay: priority = |TD error| (surprise); new transitions get top priority so each is replayed at least once; small errors still sampled, less often.优先回放：优先级 = |TD 误差|（意外程度）；新转移获得最高优先级，保证至少回放一次；误差小的仍会被抽到，只是更少。
  • Target network: a frozen copy w− computes targets y=r+γmaxb​Qw−​(s′,b); copy w−←w every C updates (C = 10,000) — targets stand still between copies, like supervised learning.目标网络：用冻结副本 w− 计算目标 y=r+γmaxb​Qw−​(s′,b)；每 C 次更新复制 w−←w（C = 10,000）——两次复制之间目标保持不动，像监督学习一样。

Results: human-level Atari from raw pixels (2015): Video Pinball 2,539% (rewards every second), Montezuma's Revenge 0% (sparse, far-away reward — ε-greedy never reaches the key). TD-Gammon (Tesauro 1992–95): self-play with TD(λ), ~300k–1.5M games.结果：从原始像素达到人类水平的 Atari（2015）：Video Pinball 2,539%（几乎每秒都有奖励），Montezuma's Revenge 0%（奖励稀疏且遥远——ε-贪心永远到不了钥匙）。TD-Gammon（Tesauro 1992–95）：用 TD(λ) 自我对弈约 30 万–150 万局。

12.7 Policy search and policy gradients12.7 策略搜索与策略梯度

Policy-based methods output a probability for each action (softmax for discrete actions; e.g. a Gaussian for continuous ones) and pick at random. Pros: continuous actions (no max over actions), naturally stochastic policies, smooth behaviour changes. Con: needs fresh data from the current policy (less sample-efficient than replay). Objective: J(θ) = expected return; climb it (gradient ascent).基于策略的方法输出每个动作的概率（离散动作用 softmax；连续动作可用高斯分布）并随机选择。优点：可处理连续动作（无需对动作取 max）、天然随机策略、行为变化平滑。缺点：需要当前策略产生的新数据（样本效率不如回放）。目标：J(θ) = 期望回报；做梯度上升。

  • Evolution strategies: no gradient — mutate the champion (θ + noise), test both, move the champion towards a better mutant. Many tries wasted (half the directions go downhill).进化策略：不用梯度——对冠军参数加噪声得到变异体，两者都测试，若变异体更好就把冠军向它移动。浪费很多尝试（一半方向是下坡）。
  • Policy gradient: make moves in winning games more likely, moves in losing games less likely (credit all moves equally, like MENACE's beads).策略梯度：让赢局中的动作更可能、输局中的动作更不可能（像 MENACE 的珠子一样平均分配功劳）。
REINFORCE (Williams 1992) with baselineREINFORCE（Williams 1992）加基线
θ←θ+η(rtotal​−b)t∑​∇θ​logπθ​(at​∣st​)
Baseline b (e.g. average score): scores 5, 8, 2 with b = 5 ⇒ weights 0, +3, −3 — only the differences carry signal. Simple but slow: one noisy number is shared by every move.基线 b（如平均分）：得分 5、8、2，b = 5 ⇒ 权重 0、+3、−3——只有差值携带信号。简单但慢：一个带噪声的总分被所有动作共享。

12.8 Actor–critic, A3C, PPO, GRPO12.8 Actor–Critic、A3C、PPO、GRPO

REINFORCE blames every move (30 good chess moves + 1 blunder ⇒ all 31 pushed down) and must wait for the episode end. Actor–critic trains two networks: the actor πθ​ (policy) and the critic Qw​ (values), giving each move its own grade immediately.REINFORCE 会责怪每一步（30 步好棋 + 1 步大错 ⇒ 31 步全部被压低），而且必须等回合结束。Actor–Critic 同时训练两个网络：演员 πθ​（策略）和评论家 Qw​（价值），立即为每一步打分。

ACTOR–CRITIC UPDATES (one step)Actor–Critic 更新（单步）
θ←θ+ηθ​Qw​(st​,at​)∇θ​logπθ​(at​∣st​)w←w+ηw​[rt​+γQw​(st+1​,at+1​)−Qw​(st​,at​)]∇w​Qw​(st​,at​)​
All methods share "(some weight) × ∇log π": REINFORCE uses rtotal​−b; actor–critic uses Q; better: the advantage A(s,a)=Q(s,a)−V(s) — "how much better than usual is this action here?". In a winning position every move scores ≈ 100, so weighting by Q pushes all up almost equally; A pushes better moves up and worse ones down ⇒ less noise.所有方法都是“（某个权重）× ∇log π”：REINFORCE 用 rtotal​−b；Actor–Critic 用 Q；更好的是优势函数 A(s,a)=Q(s,a)−V(s)——“这个动作在这里比平常好多少？”。在必胜局面中每步得分都约 100，用 Q 加权会几乎同等地推高所有动作；用 A 则推高较好的、压低较差的 ⇒ 噪声更小。
  • A3C (Asynchronous Advantage Actor–Critic, 2016): many workers, each in its own copy of the game, copy the shared weights, play up to ~5 steps, send gradients asynchronously.A3C（异步优势 Actor–Critic，2016）：许多工作进程各自玩一份游戏副本，复制共享权重、玩约 5 步、异步发送梯度。
  • PPO (Proximal Policy Optimisation, 2017; default deep-RL algorithm, used in RLHF): one huge step can wreck the policy (and the next data come from that bad policy). Collect a batch (e.g. 2,048 steps) with πold​, estimate advantages A^, then take several passes but clip the probability ratio ρ=πθ​/πold​ to [1−ϵ,1+ϵ] (ε ≈ 0.2, "±20% window"):PPO（近端策略优化，2017；深度 RL 默认算法，用于 RLHF）：一步走太大可能毁掉策略（而且下一批数据来自这个坏策略）。用 πold​ 收集一批数据（如 2,048 步），估计优势 A^，然后多轮更新，但把概率比 ρ=πθ​/πold​ 裁剪到 [1−ϵ,1+ϵ]（ε ≈ 0.2，“±20% 窗口”）：
    LCLIP=E[min(ρA^, clip(ρ,1−ϵ,1+ϵ)A^)]
    E.g. π(→|start) = 0.5 can move at most to 0.6 in batch 1; batch 2 (played with 0.6) can go to 0.72.如 π(→|start) = 0.5 在第 1 批最多只能升到 0.6；第 2 批（用 0.6 采样）可升到 0.72。
  • GRPO (Group Relative PO, DeepSeek 2024) — PPO without a critic: play the same task several times and use the group as baseline: A^i​=(ri​−mean)/std. Suits LLMs: no extra critic network as big as the model; e.g. 4 answers to "17×3?" with rewards 1,0,1,0 ⇒ A^=+1,−1,+1,−1.GRPO（组相对策略优化，DeepSeek 2024）——没有评论家的 PPO：同一任务做多次，用组内统计作基线：A^i​=(ri​−均值)/标准差。适合 LLM：不需要与模型一样大的评论家网络；如对 “17×3?” 给出 4 个答案、奖励 1,0,1,0 ⇒ A^=+1,−1,+1,−1。

12.9 Frontiers: RL for language models and agents12.9 前沿：语言模型与智能体中的强化学习

  • RLHF: LM as an RL agent (state = prompt + words so far, action = next token, policy = the LM, reward = one score at the end). Steps: (1) imitate human-written answers (supervised fine-tuning); (2) people compare two answers, a reward model learns their preferences (comparisons are more reliable than absolute scores); (3) optimise the LM with PPO against the reward model.RLHF：把语言模型视为 RL 智能体（状态 = 提示 + 已写的词，动作 = 下一个词，策略 = 语言模型，奖励 = 结尾的一个分数）。步骤：(1) 模仿人写的答案（监督微调）；(2) 人比较两个答案，奖励模型学习其偏好（比较比打绝对分更可靠）；(3) 用 PPO 针对奖励模型优化语言模型。
  • DPO (2023): same preference pairs, but no reward model and no RL loop — one classifier-like training stage that raises the preferred answer's likelihood relative to a frozen reference model.DPO（2023）：使用相同偏好对，但无需奖励模型和 RL 循环——一个类似分类器的训练阶段，相对冻结的参考模型提高被偏好答案的似然。
  • RLVR (verifiable rewards): a program checks the answer (maths answer matches; all unit tests pass) ⇒ reward 1/0; the model thinks (chain of thought) then answers; many tries per prompt compared with GRPO — e.g. OpenAI o1, DeepSeek-R1.RLVR（可验证奖励）：由程序检查答案（数学答案正确；单元测试全过）⇒ 奖励 1/0；模型先思考（思维链）再作答；每个提示多次尝试用 GRPO 比较——如 OpenAI o1、DeepSeek-R1。
  • Agents = RL agents with tools (search, code); RL environments = sandbox + task + automatic checker. World models (DreamerV3: Minecraft diamonds; Genie 3) let agents learn in imagination when real experience is expensive.智能体 = 带工具（搜索、代码）的 RL 智能体；RL 环境 = 沙盒 + 任务 + 自动检查器。世界模型（DreamerV3：Minecraft 钻石；Genie 3）让智能体在真实经验昂贵时于“想象”中学习。

Practice — Section 12练习 — 第 12 节

(Sample-exam style, 4 marks) Two states S1, S2; two actions a1, a2; deterministic. S1–a1 → S1, r = +1; S1–a2 → S2, r = 0; S2–a1 → S1, r = 0; S2–a2 → S2, r = +2. γ = 0.9. Find the optimal policy and compute V∗(S1),V∗(S2),Q∗(S1,a1),Q∗(S2,a1).（样卷题型，4 分）两个状态 S1、S2，两个动作 a1、a2，确定性。S1–a1 → S1，r = +1；S1–a2 → S2，r = 0；S2–a1 → S1，r = 0；S2–a2 → S2，r = +2。γ = 0.9。求最优策略并计算 V∗(S1),V∗(S2),Q∗(S1,a1),Q∗(S2,a1)。

Staying in S2 earns +2 forever: V∗(S2)=2/(1−0.9)=20 ⇒ π∗(S2)=a2. In S1: staying gives 1/(0.1) = 10, moving gives 0 + 0.9×20 = 18 > 10 ⇒ π∗(S1)=a2, V∗(S1)=18. Q∗(S1,a1)=1+0.9×18=17.2; Q∗(S2,a1)=0+0.9×18=16.2. (Check: Q∗(S2,a2)=2+0.9×20=20=V∗(S2) ✓.)留在 S2 永远每步 +2：V∗(S2)=2/(1−0.9)=20 ⇒ π∗(S2)=a2。在 S1：留下得 1/(0.1) = 10，移动得 0 + 0.9×20 = 18 > 10 ⇒ π∗(S1)=a2，V∗(S1)=18。Q∗(S1,a1)=1+0.9×18=17.2；Q∗(S2,a1)=0+0.9×18=16.2。（验证：Q∗(S2,a2)=2+0.9×20=20=V∗(S2) ✓。）

Numerical. TD(0): V(s)=0.5, the agent receives r=1 and lands in s′ with V(s′)=2. γ = 0.9, η = 0.1. New V(s)?数值题。TD(0)：V(s)=0.5，智能体得到 r=1 并到达 s′，V(s′)=2。γ = 0.9，η = 0.1。新的 V(s)？

Target = 1 + 0.9×2 = 2.8; TD error = 2.3; V(s)←0.5+0.1×2.3=0.73.目标 = 1 + 0.9×2 = 2.8；TD 误差 = 2.3；V(s)←0.5+0.1×2.3=0.73。

Numerical. Q-learning: Q(s,a)=2, r=−1, next-state values Q(s′,⋅)=(3,5,1), γ = 0.9, η = 0.5. New Q(s,a)?数值题。Q-learning：Q(s,a)=2，r=−1，下一状态各动作值 Q(s′,⋅)=(3,5,1)，γ = 0.9，η = 0.5。新的 Q(s,a)？

Target = −1 + 0.9×max(3,5,1) = 3.5; Q←2+0.5(3.5−2)=2.75.目标 = −1 + 0.9×max(3,5,1) = 3.5；Q←2+0.5(3.5−2)=2.75。

Rewards 0, 0, 0, then +5 every step forever, γ = 0.8. The discounted return is…奖励为 0、0、0，之后每步 +5 直到永远，γ = 0.8。折扣回报为……

  1. 25
  2. 16
  3. 12.8
  4. 20
5γ3/(1−γ)=5×0.512/0.2=12.8. (25 ignores the delay; 16 uses γ2; 20 uses γ1.)（25 忽略了延迟；16 用了 γ2；20 用了 γ1。）

Q-learning is called off-policy because…Q-learning 被称为离策略的原因是……

  1. it does not use a policy at all完全不用策略
  2. its target uses maxb​Q(s′,b), the best next action, even if the behaviour (e.g. ε-greedy) takes another action其目标用 maxb​Q(s′,b)（最佳下一动作），即使行为策略（如 ε-贪心）采取的是别的动作
  3. it needs a model of the environment需要环境模型
  4. it only updates at the end of the episode只在回合结束时更新
It learns about the greedy policy while following an exploratory one.它在执行探索性策略的同时学习贪心策略的价值。

Which is NOT a stabilisation technique used by DQN?以下哪项不是 DQN 使用的稳定化技术？

  1. experience replay经验回放
  2. a periodically copied target network定期复制的目标网络
  3. prioritised replay (in later versions)优先回放（后续版本）
  4. clipping the policy probability ratio to [0.8, 1.2]把策略概率比裁剪到 [0.8, 1.2]
Ratio clipping is PPO (a policy-gradient method).概率比裁剪属于 PPO（策略梯度方法）。

Why does the advantage A=Q−V give a better actor update than Q alone?为什么优势 A=Q−V 比单用 Q 给出更好的演员更新？

  1. It removes the state-dependent baseline, so better-than-usual actions are pushed up and worse ones down, reducing variance去掉了依赖状态的基线，比平常好的动作被推高、差的被压低，降低方差
  2. It makes the policy deterministic让策略变成确定性
  3. It removes the need for a critic不再需要评论家
  4. It equals the reward它等于奖励
In a good state Q is high for all actions; subtracting V centres the signal.在好状态下所有动作的 Q 都高；减去 V 使信号居中。

In PPO with ε = 0.2, the old policy chose an action with probability 0.5 and the advantage is positive. Within one batch, the new probability can effectively rise to at most…PPO 中 ε = 0.2，旧策略选某动作的概率为 0.5，优势为正。在一批数据内，新概率实际上最多能升到……

  1. 0.52
  2. 0.7
  3. 0.6
  4. 1.0
ρ≤1.2⇒0.5×1.2=0.6.

GRPO differs from PPO mainly in that it…GRPO 与 PPO 的主要区别在于它……

  1. uses a larger critic network使用更大的评论家网络
  2. replaces the critic with the average (and spread) of rewards in a group of tries on the same prompt用同一提示多次尝试的组内奖励均值（与标准差）代替评论家
  3. does not clip the step size不裁剪步长
  4. is value-based是基于价值的方法
A^=(r−rˉ)/σr​; step size still clipped like PPO.步长仍像 PPO 一样裁剪。

Why did DQN score 0% on Montezuma's Revenge?为什么 DQN 在 Montezuma's Revenge 上得 0%？

  1. The images were too large图像太大
  2. The discount factor was too high折扣因子太高
  3. The game has too many actions游戏动作太多
  4. Rewards are sparse and far away; ε-greedy random exploration almost never reaches the first reward奖励稀疏且遥远；ε-贪心随机探索几乎碰不到第一个奖励
No reward ever observed ⇒ nothing to learn from.从未观察到奖励 ⇒ 无从学习。

In RLHF, why do people compare two answers instead of scoring each one?在 RLHF 中，为什么让人比较两个答案而不是分别打分？

  1. People agree much more on "A is better than B" than on absolute scores; comparisons are quick and consistent人们对“A 比 B 好”的一致性远高于绝对分数；比较快且一致
  2. The reward model can only take two inputs奖励模型只能接受两个输入
  3. PPO requires pairsPPO 需要成对数据
  4. To avoid training a reward model为了避免训练奖励模型
(Avoiding the reward model is DPO's idea.)（避免奖励模型是 DPO 的思路。）

Short answer (3 marks). Compare value-based and policy-based RL: what each outputs, how it acts, how it learns, and one advantage of each.简答（3 分）。比较基于价值和基于策略的强化学习：各自输出什么、如何行动、如何学习，并各举一个优点。

Value-based (Q-learning, DQN): outputs a value for each action; acts by taking the best action (plus ε exploration); learns by fitting values to TD targets r+γmaxQ(s′,⋅). Advantage: can re-use old data (replay buffer, off-policy) ⇒ sample-efficient. Policy-based (REINFORCE, actor–critic, PPO): outputs a probability for each action; acts by sampling (randomness built in); learns by gradient ascent on expected return, making rewarded actions more likely (weight×∇logπ). Advantages: handles continuous actions, learns stochastic policies, small parameter changes give small behaviour changes; disadvantage: needs fresh on-policy data.基于价值（Q-learning、DQN）：输出每个动作的价值；行动时选最佳动作（加 ε 探索）；学习时把价值拟合到 TD 目标 r+γmaxQ(s′,⋅)。优点：可重用旧数据（回放缓冲、离策略）⇒ 样本效率高。基于策略（REINFORCE、Actor–Critic、PPO）：输出每个动作的概率；行动时采样（自带随机性）；学习时对期望回报做梯度上升，让获得奖励的动作更可能（权重×∇logπ）。优点：能处理连续动作、能学随机策略、参数小变化对应行为小变化；缺点：需要当前策略的新数据。

13Autoencoders, regularised autoencoders & variational autoencoders自编码器、正则化自编码器与变分自编码器

Slides: 5a Autoencoders对应讲义：5a Autoencoders

🎯 Define generative vs discriminative models; describe an autoencoder and its applications (sample-exam short answer); list regularised autoencoders and their penalties; explain the VAE objective and the KL term; know VAE limitations.🎯 区分生成式与判别式模型；描述自编码器及其应用（样卷简答）；列出各种正则化自编码器及其惩罚项；解释 VAE 目标函数与 KL 项；了解 VAE 的局限。

13.1 Generative vs discriminative13.1 生成式 vs 判别式

A discriminative model captures p(Y∣X) (a classifier). A generative model captures p(X) (or p(X,Y)) and can generate new data by sampling. Simplest generative model: fit a multivariate Gaussian by ML (μ = sample mean, Σ = sample covariance) and sample v∼N(0,I), x=μ+Σ1/2v. A Gaussian mixture model (fit with EM) handles multiple modes. History: ML estimation (Bayes, Lagrange…), GMM (Pearson 1894), autoencoders (Ballard 1987; nonlinear PCA, Kramer 1991), VAE (Kingma & Welling 2013), GAN (Goodfellow 2014), diffusion (2015), WGAN (2017), StyleGAN (2019), autoregressive foundation models.判别式模型刻画 p(Y∣X)（分类器）。生成式模型刻画 p(X)（或 p(X,Y)），能通过采样生成新数据。最简单的生成模型：用最大似然拟合多元高斯（μ = 样本均值，Σ = 样本协方差），再采样 v∼N(0,I)、x=μ+Σ1/2v。高斯混合模型（用 EM 拟合）可处理多峰。历史：最大似然估计（Bayes、Lagrange…）、GMM（Pearson 1894）、自编码器（Ballard 1987；非线性 PCA，Kramer 1991）、VAE（Kingma & Welling 2013）、GAN（Goodfellow 2014）、扩散模型（2015）、WGAN（2017）、StyleGAN（2019）、自回归基础模型。

13.2 Autoencoders13.2 自编码器

The output is trained to reproduce the input as closely as possible: encoder h=f(x), decoder g(h), minimise E=L(x,g(f(x))). Activations pass through a bottleneck, so the network is forced to compress the data. Image decoders use (de-)convolution: replace pooling by fractionally-strided convolution, BatchNorm, ReLU (tanh at the output) — DCGAN-style.输出被训练成尽可能重建输入：编码器 h=f(x)，解码器 g(h)，最小化 E=L(x,g(f(x)))。激活要经过瓶颈，迫使网络压缩数据。图像解码器使用（反）卷积：用分数步长卷积代替池化、BatchNorm、ReLU（输出用 tanh）——DCGAN 风格。

SAMPLE-EXAM SHORT ANSWER: "What is an autoencoder and what are some of its applications?" (3 marks)样卷简答：“什么是自编码器？有哪些应用？”（3 分）
An autoencoder is a neural network trained (unsupervised / self-supervised) to reproduce its input at its output, x^=g(f(x)), by minimising a reconstruction loss. The encoder maps the input to a lower-dimensional latent code through a bottleneck, and the decoder reconstructs from it, so the network must learn a compressed representation capturing the main structure of the data (a nonlinear generalisation of PCA). Applications: (1) dimensionality reduction / automatic feature extraction; (2) pre-training: remove the decoder, add a classification layer and fine-tune with backprop, using the learned features as initial weights; (3) denoising (denoising AE) and inpainting; (4) generating new "fake" items by feeding latent codes to the decoder (especially VAEs); (5) anomaly detection (large reconstruction error); (6) compression. Modern: masked autoencoders (MAE) for self-supervised vision pre-training. 自编码器是一种（无监督/自监督）神经网络，通过最小化重建损失，使输出重现输入 x^=g(f(x))。编码器经瓶颈把输入映射为低维潜在编码，解码器再据此重建，因此网络必须学到捕捉数据主要结构的压缩表示（PCA 的非线性推广）。应用：(1) 降维/自动特征提取；(2) 预训练：去掉解码器、加分类层，用反向传播微调，把学到的特征作为初始权重；(3) 去噪（去噪自编码器）与图像修复；(4) 把潜在编码送入解码器生成新的“假”样本（尤其是 VAE）；(5) 异常检测（重建误差大）；(6) 数据压缩。现代：掩码自编码器（MAE）用于视觉自监督预训练。

13.3 Regularised autoencoders13.3 正则化自编码器

Type类型Extra term / idea附加项/思想Effect效果
Dropout AEDropout AEdropout at hidden layer(s)隐藏层 dropoutredundant, robust codes冗余、鲁棒的编码
Sparse AE稀疏 AEE=L(x,g(f(x)))+λ∑i​∥hi​∥1​L1 on activations (analogous to weight decay, but on activations); drives many hidden units to 0 → sparse code对激活施加 L1（类似权重衰减，但作用于激活）；使很多隐藏单元为 0 → 稀疏编码
Contractive AE收缩 AEλ∑i​∥∇x​hi​∥2features change little when the input is slightly altered; reconstruction keeps them sensitive along the high-density data manifold输入轻微变化时特征变化很小；重建项使其仍对高密度数据流形方向敏感
Denoising AE去噪 AEtrain on corrupted x~ to reconstruct the original: L(x(i),g(f(x~)))输入加噪后的 x~，重建原始：L(x(i),g(f(x~)))robust features, denoising鲁棒特征、去噪
Wasserstein AEWasserstein AEmatch latent distribution to a prior with Wasserstein distance用 Wasserstein 距离使潜在分布匹配先验sharper generations than VAE生成比 VAE 更清晰

Loss ↔ probability: SSE assumes a Gaussian whose mean is the output; cross-entropy assumes a Bernoulli; softmax assumes a Boltzmann distribution. So the decoder defines pθ​(x∣z); a stochastic encoder defines qϕ​(z∣x).损失 ↔ 概率：平方误差假设以输出为均值的高斯；交叉熵假设伯努利；softmax 假设玻尔兹曼分布。所以解码器定义了 pθ​(x∣z)；随机编码器定义 qϕ​(z∣x)。

13.4 Variational autoencoder (VAE)13.4 变分自编码器（VAE）

Goal: choose z from a standard normal p(z), feed it to the decoder, and get a new item similar to the training data. Generative models can be explicit (VAE, WAE) or implicit (GAN). In a VAE the encoder outputs a mean μz∣x​ and standard deviation σz∣x​, defining qϕ​(z∣x(i)); train to maximise目标：从标准正态 p(z) 中选 z、送入解码器，得到与训练数据相似的新样本。生成模型可以是显式的（VAE、WAE）或隐式的（GAN）。VAE 的编码器输出均值 μz∣x​ 和标准差 σz∣x​，定义 qϕ​(z∣x(i))；训练目标是最大化

VAE OBJECTIVEVAE 目标
Ez∼qϕ​(z∣x(i))​[logpθ​(x(i)∣z)]−DKL​(qϕ​(z∣x(i))∥p(z))​
1st term (reconstruction): any z sampled from the conditional distribution should decode to something close to x(i). 2nd term (regulariser): pushes qϕ​(z∣x) towards the standard normal — centred at 0, spread out. In practice the q for different x occupy complementary regions of p(z), so sampling z∼N(0,I) gives sensible outputs. Sampling is done as z=μ+σ⊙ϵ, ϵ∼N(0,I) so gradients can flow (reparameterisation). 第一项（重建）：从条件分布采样的任意 z 解码后都应接近 x(i)。第二项（正则）：把 qϕ​(z∣x) 推向标准正态——以 0 为中心并铺开。实际中不同 x 的 q 占据 p(z) 中互补的区域，因此采样 z∼N(0,I) 能得到合理输出。采样写成 z=μ+σ⊙ϵ, ϵ∼N(0,I)，使梯度可以回传（重参数化）。
DKL​(q∥p)=21​(∥μ∥2+i∑​(σi2​−2logσi​−1))minimised when μ=0, σi​=1​

Information view: entropy H(q) = bits needed to transmit a sample from q; DKL​(q∥p) = extra bits if the code was designed for p. VAE limitations: reasonable results but blurry images; often uses only a small number of latent dimensions. The Wasserstein autoencoder minimises the Wasserstein distance instead of KL. Modern take: Masked Image Modelling / Masked Autoencoders (MAE): hide most image patches and reconstruct them — scalable self-supervised pre-training.信息论视角：熵 H(q) = 传输 q 的一个样本所需比特；DKL​(q∥p) = 编码按 p 设计时多出的比特。VAE 的局限：结果尚可但图像模糊；常常只用了少数几个潜在维度。Wasserstein 自编码器最小化 Wasserstein 距离而非 KL。现代做法：掩码图像建模/掩码自编码器（MAE）：遮住大部分图像块再重建——可扩展的自监督预训练。

Practice — Section 13练习 — 第 13 节

(Sample exam, 3 marks) What is an Autoencoder and what are some of its applications?（样卷，3 分）什么是自编码器？它有哪些应用？

See the boxed model answer in 13.2: network trained to reproduce its input through a bottleneck (encoder → latent code → decoder, reconstruction loss), learning a compressed representation. Applications: dimensionality reduction/feature extraction, pre-training for supervised tasks, denoising, generation of new items (VAE), anomaly detection, compression.见 13.2 方框中的参考答案：通过瓶颈重建输入的网络（编码器 → 潜在编码 → 解码器，重建损失），学到压缩表示。应用：降维/特征提取、监督任务的预训练、去噪、生成新样本（VAE）、异常检测、压缩。

A sparse autoencoder adds which penalty?稀疏自编码器添加的惩罚项是？

  1. λ∑j​wj2​
  2. λ∑i​∣hi​∣
  3. λ∑i​∥∇x​hi​∥2
  4. DKL​(q(z∣x)∥p(z))
L1 on hidden activations → many become exactly 0. (C) is contractive; (A) is weight decay; (D) is the VAE term.对隐藏激活施加 L1 → 许多恰好为 0。（C）是收缩 AE；（A）是权重衰减；（D）是 VAE 项。

How is a denoising autoencoder trained?去噪自编码器如何训练？

  1. On clean inputs, with noise added to the weights用干净输入，在权重上加噪声
  2. To output the noise pattern输出噪声图案
  3. The input is a corrupted version x~; the target is the original x输入是损坏后的 x~；目标是原始 x
  4. With a discriminator judging the output由判别器评判输出
E=L(x(i),g(f(x~))).

In the VAE objective, the KL term DKL​(qϕ​(z∣x)∥p(z)) …VAE 目标中的 KL 项 DKL​(qϕ​(z∣x)∥p(z)) ……

  1. encourages each encoder distribution to be close to the standard normal prior, so sampling z∼N(0,I) gives meaningful outputs鼓励每个编码器分布接近标准正态先验，使采样 z∼N(0,I) 能得到有意义的输出
  2. measures reconstruction quality衡量重建质量
  3. is maximised during training训练中被最大化
  4. makes the decoder deterministic让解码器确定化
It is subtracted (so minimised); the first term measures reconstruction.它被减去（即被最小化）；第一项衡量重建。

Numerical. An encoder outputs μ=(0.5,−0.5), σ=(1,0.5). Compute the KL term to N(0,I) (natural log, 3 d.p.).数值题。编码器输出 μ=(0.5,−0.5)，σ=(1,0.5)。求到 N(0,I) 的 KL 项（自然对数，三位小数）。

∥μ∥2=0.5. Dim 1:维 1： 1−0−1=0. Dim 2:维 2： 0.25−2ln0.5−1=0.25+1.386−1=0.636. DKL​=21​(0.5+0+0.636)=0.568.

Which is a commonly noted limitation of VAEs?以下哪项是 VAE 常见的局限？

  1. They cannot be trained with backprop不能用反向传播训练
  2. They need labelled data需要标注数据

Mode collapse is the classic GAN problem.模式崩溃是 GAN 的典型问题。

A discriminative model captures…, a generative model captures…判别式模型刻画……，生成式模型刻画……

  1. p(X); p(Y∣X)
  2. p(Y∣X); p(X) or或 p(X,Y)

To sample from N(μ,Σ) using standard normal samples v, compute…用标准正态样本 v 从 N(μ,Σ) 采样，应计算……

  1. μ+Σv
