14Adversarial training: artist–critic co-evolution, GANs, adversarial examples对抗训练：艺术家–评论家协同进化、GAN、对抗样本

Slides: 5b Adversarial对应讲义：5b Adversarial

🎯 Explain the artist–critic paradigm; write the GAN minimax objective and the alternating training algorithm (with the non-saturating generator loss); list DCGAN design rules; explain oscillation and mode collapse and remedies; define adversarial examples.🎯 解释艺术家–评论家范式；写出 GAN 的极小极大目标与交替训练算法（含非饱和生成器损失）；列出 DCGAN 设计规则；解释振荡与模式崩溃及对策；定义对抗样本。

14.1 Artist–critic co-evolution14.1 艺术家–评论家协同进化

The Artist is rewarded for fooling the Critic into thinking generated images are real; the Critic is rewarded for distinguishing real images from generated ones. Earlier paradigms: Blind Watchmaker (Dawkins 1986: human picks from 15 biomorphs to breed the next generation), Interactive Evolution (Sims 1991: genetic-program artist computes R,G,B for each pixel, human critic), PicBreeder (Secretan 2011: CPPN artist, web users breed images). Interactive evolution needs lots of human work → replace the human with an automated critic (GP or NN critic → evolutionary art; CNN artist + CNN critic → GANs).艺术家因骗过评论家（使其认为生成图是真的）而得到奖励；评论家因区分真实图像与生成图像而得到奖励。早期范式：盲眼钟表匠（Dawkins 1986：人从 15 个生物形态中挑选来繁殖下一代）、交互式进化（Sims 1991：遗传程序作艺术家，为每个像素计算 R,G,B；人作评论家）、PicBreeder（Secretan 2011：CPPN 作艺术家，网友繁殖图像）。交互式进化需要大量人工 → 用自动评论家替代人（GP 或 NN 评论家 → 进化艺术；CNN 艺术家 + CNN 评论家 → GAN）。

14.2 Generative Adversarial Networks (Goodfellow 2014)14.2 生成对抗网络（Goodfellow 2014）

Generator Gθ​:z↦x (deep (de)convolutional net) produces an image from latent z∼ standard normal; Discriminator Dψ​:x↦(0,1) estimates the probability that an image is real. They play a two-player zero-sum game:生成器 Gθ​:z↦x（深度（反）卷积网络）从潜在变量 z∼ 标准正态生成图像；判别器 Dψ​:x↦(0,1) 估计图像为真的概率。二者进行双人零和博弈：

GAN OBJECTIVEGAN 目标
θmin​ψmax​  Ex∼pdata​​[logDψ​(x)]+Ez∼pmodel​​[log(1−Dψ​(Gθ​(z)))]​
D maximises (classify correctly), G minimises. Alternate: gradient ascent on D with the full expression; for G, minimising log(1−D(G(z))) gives tiny gradients when D confidently rejects the fakes (early training), so instead do gradient ascent on Ez​[logDψ​(Gθ​(z))] — this puts more emphasis on images that are wrongly classified (the "non-saturating" loss). D 最大化（分对），G 最小化。交替进行：对 D 用完整表达式做梯度上升；对 G，若最小化 log(1−D(G(z)))，当 D 自信地拒绝假图（训练早期）时梯度极小，所以改为对 Ez​[logDψ​(Gθ​(z))] 做梯度上升——更重视被判错的图像（“非饱和”损失）。
TRAINING ALGORITHM训练算法
repeat:
  for k steps:
     sample m latents z(1..m) ~ p(z);  sample m real images x(1..m)
     update D by gradient ASCENT on ψ:
        (1/m) Σ [ log D(x(i)) + log(1 − D(G(z(i)))) ]
  sample m latents; update G by gradient ASCENT on θ:
        (1/m) Σ log D(G(z(i)))
Properties: one network aims to produce the full range of images for different z; differentials are backpropagated through the discriminator into the generator; images much more realistic than earlier approaches.性质：一个网络针对不同的 z 生成各种图像；微分穿过判别器反传到生成器；生成的图像比以往方法逼真得多。
DCGAN ARCHITECTURE RULES (Radford et al. 2016)DCGAN 结构规则（Radford 等 2016）
normalise images to [−1, +1] · replace pooling by strided convolutions (D) and fractionally-strided convolutions (G) · BatchNorm in both · remove fully-connected hidden layers · G: ReLU everywhere, tanh at the output · D: LeakyReLU everywhere.图像归一化到 [−1, +1] · 用带步长卷积（D）和分数步长卷积（G）代替池化 · 两者都用 BatchNorm · 去掉全连接隐藏层 · G：全部 ReLU，输出层 tanh · D：全部 LeakyReLU。

14.3 Failure modes and improvements14.3 失败模式与改进

  • Oscillation: trains for a long time, producing variety, but quality fails to improve (co-evolutionary dynamics).振荡：训练很久、生成多样，但质量不再提高（协同进化动力学所致）。
  • Mode collapse: G produces only a small subset of the desired range, or converges to a single image with minor variations.模式崩溃：G 只生成目标范围的一小部分，或收敛到单一图像（只有微小变化）。
  • Remedies: conditioning augmentation, minibatch features (fitness sharing — D sees statistics of the whole minibatch, so lack of diversity is detectable), unrolled GANs; Wasserstein GAN (Arjovsky 2017) uses the Wasserstein distance for smoother training.对策：条件增强、小批量特征（适应度共享——D 看到整个小批量的统计，能察觉多样性不足）、展开 GAN；Wasserstein GAN（Arjovsky 2017）用 Wasserstein 距离使训练更平滑。
  • Latent vector arithmetic: e.g. (man with glasses) − (man) + (woman) ≈ woman with glasses. GAN zoo: context encoders (inpainting), conditional GAN, text-to-image (StackGAN), patch-based discriminator, StyleGAN, plug-and-play generative networks.潜在向量运算：如 (戴眼镜的男人) − (男人) + (女人) ≈ 戴眼镜的女人。GAN 动物园：上下文编码器（修复）、条件 GAN、文本生成图像（StackGAN）、基于图像块的判别器、StyleGAN、即插即用生成网络。

14.4 Adversarial examples14.4 对抗样本

Adversarial examples are inputs tailored to confuse a network while looking visually almost identical to natural examples (Szegedy et al. 2014; Goodfellow et al. 2015). They are made by gradient ascent at the image level: compute the gradient of the loss w.r.t. the pixels and nudge the image to increase the loss (e.g. panda → "gibbon"). Adversarial training adds such examples to the training set to improve robustness.对抗样本是专门构造的输入，看起来与自然样本几乎一样，却能迷惑网络（Szegedy 等 2014；Goodfellow 等 2015）。生成方法是在图像层面做梯度上升：计算损失对像素的梯度，微调图像以增大损失（如熊猫 → “长臂猿”）。对抗训练把这类样本加入训练集以提高鲁棒性。

Practice — Section 14练习 — 第 14 节

In practice, the GAN generator is trained by…实际中 GAN 的生成器通过什么训练？

  1. gradient descent on logD(G(z))对 logD(G(z)) 梯度下降
  2. gradient ascent on logD(G(z)), which gives stronger gradients when D rejects the fakes对 logD(G(z)) 梯度上升，在 D 拒绝假图时梯度更强
  3. minimising reconstruction error最小化重建误差
  4. maximising log(1−D(G(z)))最大化 log(1−D(G(z)))
Minimising log(1−D(G(z))) saturates early; the slides recommend ascent on logD(G(z)).最小化 log(1−D(G(z))) 早期会饱和；讲义建议对 logD(G(z)) 做上升。

A GAN produces nearly the same face no matter what z is. This is called…某 GAN 无论 z 是什么都生成几乎相同的人脸。这叫……

  1. overfitting过拟合
  2. vanishing gradient梯度消失
  3. oscillation振荡
  4. mode collapse模式崩溃
Remedies: minibatch features, conditioning augmentation, unrolled GANs, WGAN.对策：小批量特征、条件增强、展开 GAN、WGAN。

Which is a DCGAN guideline?以下哪项是 DCGAN 的设计准则？

  1. Use tanh at the generator output and LeakyReLU in the discriminator生成器输出用 tanh，判别器用 LeakyReLU
  2. Use max pooling in both networks两个网络都用最大池化
  3. Use sigmoid in all generator layers生成器所有层用 sigmoid
  4. Add several fully connected hidden layers for deeper models深层模型多加几层全连接隐藏层
Pooling → strided / fractionally-strided convs; remove FC hidden layers.池化 → 带步长/分数步长卷积；去掉全连接隐藏层。

The discriminator's output for a real image should approach…, and the generator wants D(G(z)) to approach…判别器对真实图像的输出应趋近……，而生成器希望 D(G(z)) 趋近……

  1. 0; 0
  2. 0; 1
  3. 1; 1
  4. 1; 0
D estimates P(real); G wants its fakes judged real.D 估计 P(真实)；G 希望假图被判为真。

Adversarial examples are typically generated by…对抗样本通常怎样生成？

  1. training a second network on random noise在随机噪声上训练第二个网络
  2. gradient ascent on the loss with respect to the input pixels, keeping the change visually small对输入像素做损失的梯度上升，同时保持改动在视觉上很小
  3. removing the last layer of the classifier去掉分类器最后一层
  4. heavy data augmentation大量数据增强
"Gradient ascent at the image level".“在图像层面做梯度上升”。

Short answer (3 marks). Compare VAEs and GANs as generative models.简答（3 分）。比较作为生成模型的 VAE 与 GAN。

Both map a latent z∼N(0,I) through a decoder/generator to an image. VAE is an explicit probabilistic model: an encoder outputs μ,σ of q(z∣x); training maximises reconstruction log-likelihood minus DKL​(q(z∣x)∥p(z)); training is stable and gives a useful encoder, but samples tend to be blurry. GAN is implicit: no encoder or likelihood; a discriminator is trained to tell real from fake and the generator is trained (via gradients through D) to fool it in a minimax game; samples are much sharper/more realistic, but training can oscillate or suffer mode collapse.二者都把潜在 z∼N(0,I) 经解码器/生成器映射为图像。VAE 是显式概率模型：编码器输出 q(z∣x) 的 μ,σ；训练最大化重建对数似然减去 DKL​(q(z∣x)∥p(z))；训练稳定且得到有用的编码器，但样本偏模糊。GAN 是隐式模型：没有编码器和似然；判别器学习区分真假，生成器（经由 D 的梯度）在极小极大博弈中学习骗过它；样本更清晰逼真，但训练可能振荡或模式崩溃。
